title: Associate Professor in Clinical Pharmacy
description:
Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy, and Environmental Medicine at the Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health, University of Southern Denmark, is offering a new 5-year (20%) position for an Associate Professor within clinical pharmacy. The position is to be filled from February 1st, 2027.

The academic position

The research areas of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM) span from pharmacological epidemiology to clinical studies and cell-based basic pharmacology. CPPEM has a strong background in investigations of exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. The academic position is affiliated with the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, that utilizes the Danish registries to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. 

The area of research is flexible within the area of pharmacoepidemiologic and clinical research and could be (but is not limited to) drug use patterns and rational pharmacotherapy. The department has a strong focus on interdisciplinary collaboration both in-house and with external researchers and the new person is expected to continue this tradition.
 

Areas of responsibility

The applicant will be expected to establish their own research area within the pharmacoepidemiologic research group at the department. Thus, the applicant should be able to attract external research funding to support research and employ scientific and technical staff. The applicant may have a background within pharmacy or medicine.

The research unit teaches in four educations: Medicine, Pharmacy, Chiropractor, and Biomedicine, and the position comes with teaching obligations within these subjects at the University as well as supervision of bachelor and master projects. Additionally, we expect that you will contribute to administrative duties, e.g., participating in Study Board or other similar activities. 

Fluent English (both written and spoken) is required. You are expected to have qualifications that renders it probable that you will be able to establish your own research area within the research unit. Further, you are required to have a PhD degree or similar research experience. 
 

Employers

Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine today has approximately 50 employees. It consists of three separate research groups: pharmacoepidemiology, translational pharmacology, and environmental medicine. Additionally, it collaborates closely with the Department of Pharmacology at OUH. Collectively, this constitutes Denmark’s largest center for research, teaching and clinical service in pharmacology.

It produces approximately 100 international peer-reviewed publications per year. 

Professor Tore B. Stage heads the unit and Professor Pernille Tanggaard Andersen heads the Department.


Management

The Associate Professor answers to the research leader for the unit of Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine.
 

Contact information

Further information can be obtained from the leader for the pharmacoepidemiologic research group, Professor Anton Pottegård (apottegaard@health.sdu.dk).
 

Application deadline and interviews

November 1, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. CET
 

Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Applications will be assessed by an expert committee. Applicants will be informed of their assessment by the university.

Applications – including the required attachments – must be sent via the below-mentioned link “Apply online". Only online applications will be accepted. Attached files must be Adobe PDF or Word format. Each field in the application form can contain up to max. 10 MB.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.
 

Application (as pdf- or Word/docx- files):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of PhD diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 10 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please notice that one pdf- or docx- file must be attached for each publication

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a research plan detailing the candidate’s ideas and plans for her/his future research work

Incomplete applications regarding the above-mentioned requirements will not be assessed.

References will be obtained for the applicant who is the first choice for the position – from the applicant’s most recent employer and previous employers as required.

Further particulars concerning the application – please see the link below.
 

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark is a world-class university driven by an ambition to promote research results that develop society. The major challenges of the 21st century are complex and multifaceted; sustainable change and solutions require new – often interdisciplinary – research-based knowledge, and the University of Southern Denmark is an indispensable stakeholder in the transition process. 

Value, quality, talented people and outstanding environments are pivotal for the University of Southern Denmark’s strategic initiatives. 

Read more: https://www.sdu.dk/en/om_sdu

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

title: Kompetent lægesekretær eller klinikassistent søges til velfungerende speciallægepraksis i øre- næse- halssygdomme.
employer: Speciallæge i øre-, næse- og halssygdomme v/ Gitte Obel
description:
Kompetent lægesekretær eller klinikassistent søges til velfungerende speciallægepraksis i øre- næse- halssygdomme.

 

Øre-næse-halsklinikken i Vejen er en speciallægeklinik med én fast speciallæge og én

konsultationssygeplejerske samt én lægesekretær. Vores dygtige sekretær søger nye udfordringer, hvorfor vi søger en ny medarbejder til et alsidigt og spændende job.

 

Om jobbet

Vi søger en dygtig,  engageret og arbejdsom medarbejder. Arbejdet foregår i tæt samarbejde med sygeplejersken og speciallægen. Vi har godt humør i hverdagen. Antallet af timer kan aftales fra 25-30 timer fordelt på 4-5 hverdage.

Arbejdsdagen består blandt andet af visitering af patienter i telefontiden som er ca. 2-3 timer dagligt. Desuden er der flere afvekslende opgaver såsom høreprøver, allergitest, lungefunktionsundersøgelse, svimmelhedsundersøgelser samt rengøring af instrumenter. Du vil blive grundigt oplært i alle opgaver. Der er desuden operationsdage i fuld bedøvelse, hvor du skal hjælpe til.

 

Om dig

Vi forventer en god arbejdsmoral med glæde og godt humør til patienterne. Det er vigtigt med gode kommunikative egenskaber og imødekommenhed. Du har gåpåmod, er sympatisk og pligtopfyldende.

Det er vigtigt, at du er robust og kan håndtere en til tider travl hverdag i klinikken.

Vi forestiller os, at du har en uddannelse som enten lægesekretær eller klinikassistent, men hvis du passer ind i vores team og har den rette indstilling, er uddannelsen mindre vigtig.

 

Om os

Vi tilbyder en fantastisk arbejdsplads med en varieret arbejdsdag, gode kolleger og supervision. Vi sætter patientens velvære i klinikken højt og bidrager med godt humør. Faglighed og ordentlighed er i højsæde.

 

Løn efter overenskomst og individuel aftale

Ansøgningsfrist: 09.10.2026

Ansættelse: pr. 01.11.2026 eller efter aftale.

Ansøgningen sendes til: otolog.vejen@hotmail.com

Yderligere information om stillingen, kontakt til speciallæge Gitte Obel på tlf. 23615532 efter kl. 16.00

title: Postdoc in intestinal regeneration and mucosal immunology
description:
A full-time (100%) postdoctoral position is available in the lab of Dr. Srustidhar Das, at the Department of Clinical Research and at the Research Unit of Inflammation Research, Department of Molecular Medicine, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark. The position is limited to two years, with the possibility of extension subject to funding.

Research tasks

The position comprises research, teaching, professional development and supervision within intestinal tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology and inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). The postdoc will join a translational research programme that investigates how inflammation reshapes the intestinal epithelium and its surrounding tissue niche, and how these changes can be targeted to promote safe and durable mucosal healing.

The successful candidate will combine patient-derived organoid and co-culture models with molecular biology, functional assays, and computational analysis of single-cell and spatial datasets. The position is particularly suited to a researcher who can connect experimental biology with bioinformatics and clinically relevant questions.

Research environment

The postdoc will be embedded in a dynamic and highly collaborative research environment spanning the Department of Clinical Research and the Department of Molecular Medicine at SDU. The project benefits from close interaction among basic scientists, clinicians, bioinformaticians and translational researchers, with strong links to Odense University Hospital and access to patient-derived material, advanced disease models and state-of-the-art molecular technologies.

The environment provides excellent opportunities to develop an independent research profile, contribute to clinically relevant discoveries in IBD and tissue regeneration, and build collaborations across experimental, computational and clinical disciplines.

Research project

The project investigates how inflammatory history establishes persistent epithelial and niche memory, shapes epithelial plasticity and influences intestinal regeneration in IBD. Using patient-derived biopsies, intestinal organoids, fibroblasts and immune-cell co-cultures, we will determine how epithelial memory and injury-induced cell-state transitions influence regenerative capacity and distinguish effective from impaired mucosal healing.

Functional experiments will be integrated with single-cell RNA sequencing, chromatin-accessibility analysis, spatial transcriptomics and spatial epigenomics. CRISPR-engineered patient-derived organoids, including lineage reporters and targeted genetic perturbations, will be used to trace epithelial cell states and validate candidate mechanisms. Selected organoids will also be tested in engraftment models to determine whether regenerative phenotypes translate into improved tissue integration and repair in vivo.

Key responsibilities

  • Establish and manipulate patient-derived intestinal organoids and fibroblast–immune-cell co-cultures to investigate epithelial plasticity, cell-state transitions, regeneration, inflammatory responses and barrier function.

  • Generate and validate CRISPR-engineered organoids, including reporter lines and targeted genetic perturbations, and perform engraftment studies to assess regenerative potential in vivo.

  • Analyse and integrate scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic and spatial epigenomic datasets using reproducible workflows for quality control, differential analysis, cell-state annotation, trajectory analysis and multimodal integration.

  • Apply molecular and cellular methods, including qPCR, immunostaining, advanced microscopy, flow cytometry and ELISA-based assays, and validate candidate pathways using pharmacological and CRISPR-based perturbations where appropriate.

  • Collaborate with clinicians, experimental scientists and bioinformaticians to analyse and interpret patient-derived samples and data.

  • Maintain accurate and reproducible records, present findings, prepare manuscripts and conference contributions, and contribute to grant applications, teaching and supervision where relevant.

Expectations of qualifications

The successful applicant must hold a PhD in molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, bioinformatics, computational biology, regenerative medicine, biomedicine or a closely related discipline, with documented research experience relevant to the project.

Essential qualifications

  • Documented experience in organoid biology, preferably involving intestinal or other tissue-derived epithelial organoids, and in designing mechanistic studies of epithelial plasticity and regeneration.

  • A strong background in tissue regeneration, epithelial biology, mucosal immunology, inflammatory disease or a closely related field.

  • Demonstrated expertise in analysing single-cell or spatial-omics data, with proficiency in R and/or Python and experience developing reproducible computational workflows.

  • Hands-on experience in molecular and cell biology, with the ability to design, perform, troubleshoot and interpret experiments using a structured and careful approach to data analysis, documentation and responsible research practice.

  • A strong publication record appropriate to career stage; excellent written and spoken English; and the ability to drive projects independently while collaborating effectively in a multidisciplinary and international environment.

Desirable qualifications

  • Experience with intestinal organoids, patient-derived material, fibroblast or immune-cell culture, or epithelial–stromal–immune co-culture models.

  • Experience integrating scRNA-seq, scATAC-seq, spatial transcriptomic, spatial epigenomic or other multimodal datasets.

  • Familiarity with advanced imaging, quantitative image analysis, flow cytometry, organoid phenotyping or high-content screening.

  • Demonstrated experience generating and validating CRISPR-engineered organoids, including knock-in reporters or targeted gene perturbations, and with intestinal organoid engraftment or transplantation and in vivo assessment of epithelial regeneration is highly preferred.

  • An interest in supervising junior researchers and contributing to collaborative teaching and research activities.

Research strategy for OUH and the Department of Clinical Research

The joint research strategy for the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital sets the direction for our shared research efforts in the years ahead. Rooted in the vision –We conduct research together to shape the patient care of the future – it focuses in particular on: cross-disciplinary research – with people at the centre; strong research environments – as drivers of development; and the research journey – from idea to impact. Further information on the joint research strategy of the Department of Clinical Research and Odense University Hospital is available here.

Further information 

For further information, please contact Dr. Srustidhar Das, Department of Clinical Research and Department of Molecular Medicine, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), tel.: +45 71504339, e-mail: srudas@health.sdu.dk

Application deadline

November 1, 2026 at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Salary and terms of employment

The applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

The position as Postdoc is placed within salary steps 4–8 of the Danish state salary scale, depending on seniority. In addition, a centrally agreed postdoc allowance is paid, and further qualification- and function-related allowances may be negotiated.

The work location will be at Campusvej 55, 5230 Odense M, Denmark.

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link “Apply now” - see below.

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

Only applications written in English will be accepted for evaluation.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

  • a motivation letter

  • a detailed CV

  • degree certificates (inclusive of Ph.D.-diploma)

  • a complete and numbered list of publications

  • 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. Please note that a copy of each publication must be attached as a pdf file.

    • It is permitted to merge copies of the selected publications into a single PDF file.

  • a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

  • a detailed description of research experience

  • an explanation of other qualifications relevant to the position

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered.

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Kundens maskinpark omfatter alt fra gamle maskiner med relæstyring til nye produktionsanlæg med PLC, HMI og robotter. Du arbejder med alt fra fejlfinding på eksisterende anlæg til design og programmering af nye styringer – og både med el, mekanik og pneumatik. Du skal derfor trives med praktiske opgaver, hvor du indimellem får snavsede fingre. Vi forbereder løbende kundens produktionsanlæg med fokus på sikkerhed, driftsoptimering og betjening – og fungerer som kundens tætte rådgiver.

Dine kvalifikationer

Vi forventer, at du er uddannet elektriker, tekniker eller lign. og har erfaring med eller flair for PLC-programmering; gerne Rockwell og Siemens. Du har den rette indstilling, bidrager positivt og tager ansvar for opgaven, indtil den er løst. Du hjælper dine kollegaer og holder den gode tone – og er derudover mødestabil.

Kjærgaard tilbyder dig

Du får en spændende stilling i en lille afdeling med ordnede forhold, kompetence kollegaer og gode muligheder for personlig udvikling i et selvstændigt og udfordrende miljø. Efter endt oplæring skal du deltage i vores vagtordning (ca. hver 8-10. uge). Du kommer til at arbejde i et uformelt miljø, hvor vi vægter samarbejde, kvalitet og faglig stolthed højt. Du får en central rolle i vores værksted og bliver en del af et stærkt hold.

  • et alsidigt job hvor du både arbejder med montage, service og tilpasning

  • frihed under ansvar og mulighed for selv at præge din hverdag

  • et fagligt stærkt miljø med gode kolleger og en uformel omgangstone

  • en arbejdsplads hvor vi prioriterer trivsel og ordnede forhold

  • løn efter kvalifikationer

Du skal kunne identificere dig i overensstemmelse med vores værdisæt K7.

Ansøgning og CV

Vi arbejder på at besætte stillingen hurtigst muligt og tager ansøgere ind løbende. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte divisionschef Michael Haislund på mih@kia.dk eller 4080 0097.

Send din ansøgning ved at klikke på “Søg stillingen”-knappen til højre. Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende.

title: Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt
description:
Selskabskoordinator hos Smag & Slægt

Er du detaljeorienteret, serviceminded og god til at holde mange bolde i luften?

Hos Smag & Slægt søger vi en engageret Selskabskoordinator på fuld tid, som brænder for at skabe den bedste oplevelse for vores gæster – længe før de træder ind ad døren.

Du bliver den gennemgående kontaktperson for vores selskaber og arrangementer. Fra første tilbud til den endelige bekræftelse og opfølgning sikrer du, at alle detaljer er på plads, og at både gæster og kollegaer føler sig i trygge hænder.

Dine arbejdsopgaver

  • Udarbejdelse af tilbud og bekræftelser på selskaber og arrangementer.

  • Opfølgning på eksisterende og kommende selskaber.

  • Håndtering af gæstehenvendelser via mail og kontortelefon.

  • Oversættelse og korrekturlæsning af materiale på engelsk.

  • Daglig administration af vores bookingsystemer

  • Betjening af vagttelefonen

  • Tæt samarbejde med køkken, Front of House og salgsafdelingen for at sikre en gnidningsfri afvikling.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • Er struktureret og har sans for detaljen.

  • Har erfaring med administration, booking eller koordinering – gerne fra restaurations-, hotel- eller eventbranchen.

  • Trives med kundekontakt og sætter en ære i at yde en professionel service.

  • Kommunikerer på dansk og har gode engelskkundskaber – både skriftligt og mundtligt.

  • Er fortrolig med IT-systemer og lærer hurtigt nye programmer.

  • Bevarer overblikket, også når tempoet er højt.

Din arbejdsdag

Du får en fast kontorplads, men ikke fast arbejdstid hos Smag & Slægt. Du bliver omdrejningspunktet for koordineringen af vores selskaber og arrangementer. Her håndterer du bookingforespørgsler, udarbejder tilbud, følger op på gæster og sikrer, at alle detaljer er på plads inden afviklingen.

Selvom din primære arbejdsplads er kontoret, skal du forvente at være en synlig del af huset ved større arrangementer. Her hjælper du med koordinering og fungerer som bindeled mellem gæsterne og vores drift, så arrangementerne forløber professionelt og gnidningsfrit.

Det er en stilling for dig, der motiveres af at skabe struktur, tage ansvar og være med til at levere oplevelser, hvor intet er overladt til tilfældighederne.

Arbejdstid og ansættelse

  • Fuldtidsstilling

  • Primær arbejdstid er kl. 12.00–20.00.

  • Fri hver anden weekend.

  • Der må forventes fleksibilitet i forbindelse med større arrangementer, samt deltagelse i vagttelefonordningen efter nærmere aftale.

  • Fast arbejdsplads hos Smag & Slægt.

Vi tilbyder

  • En spændende og alsidig stilling med stor kontaktflade.

  • Et passioneret team med fokus på kvalitet, samarbejde og gæsteoplevelser.

  • En arbejdsplads, hvor ordentlighed, værtskab og gastronomi går hånd i hånd.

  • Mulighed for personlig og faglig udvikling.

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send din ansøgning og CV til os. Vi afholder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Chef for Trading afdeling, Meldgaard Miljø, Miljøpladser, Kolding
description:
Meldgaard har i mange år sorteret og håndteret affald, jord og genbrugsprodukter. I dag har vi miljøcentre/modtageanlæg i bl.a. Kolding, Klintholm, Herning, Aabenraa og posesortering i Aalborg. 
Afdelingerne har været igennem en kraftig udvikling med masser af nye aktiviteter i en spændende branche. 
Hovedaktiviteterne på pladserne er håndtering af jord, have-/parkaffald, træ og øvrige affaldsfraktioner, der kommer ind på de forskellige pladser. 
Vi har en uformel omgangstone med gensidig respekt for hinanden og har med udgangspunkt fra kontoret i Kolding tæt kontakt med alle modtageanlæg samt vores hovedkontor i Aabenraa. Vi er et stærkt team med en ambition om at have tilfredse kunder og levere kvalitet hver gang.

Om jobbet
Som chef for Trading (træ, metal m.m.) får du ansvaret for den daglige ledelse og videreudvikling af afdelingen. Du leder et mindre team og står for styring og koordinering af samarbejdet med kunder, samarbejdspartnere og relevante specialister.

Der er tale om et forretningsområde i vækst, og du får en central rolle i både den strategiske og kommercielle udvikling af området.

Stillingen er placeret i Kolding, og du refererer direkte til direktøren for området. For den rette kandidat vil stillingen på sigt kunne medføre deltagelse i chefgruppen i Meldgaard-koncernen. 

Om dig
Vi søger en leder, der kan være det stabile omdrejningspunkt i en travl hverdag. Du bevarer overblikket, skaber struktur og sætter en tydelig retning, samtidig med at du bidrager med positiv energi og skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor medarbejderne trives og udvikler sig.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en lignende lederstilling - dog betyder det rigtige mindset mere end tidligere titel 
  • Har stærke kommercielle kompetencer og en veludviklet købmandsmæssig forståelse 
  • Er en dygtig leder, der kan skabe engagement og følgeskab 
  • Trives med ansvar og evner at skabe struktur i komplekse processer 
  • Er resultatorienteret og motiveres af at udvikle forretning

Det er samtidig vigtigt at du:

  • Kan sætte en tydelig retning og sikre opfølgning på mål og aktiviteter 
  • Er stærk i relationer og samarbejde med både kunder, leverandører og kolleger 
  • Har gennemslagskraft og naturlig autoritet 
  • Kan bevare roen og overblikket, også når tempoet er højt 
  • Bidrager aktivt til en positiv kultur og et godt arbejdsmiljø

Hos Meldgaard kan vi tilbyde en spændende og udfordrende stilling med gode løn- og ansættelsesforhold i en velkonsolideret familievirksomhed med over 55 års erfaring. Vores omgangstone er åben og uformel, og der er frihed under ansvar med korte kommandoveje. 

Har du uddybende spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte direktør Henrik Meldgaard pr. mail hm@meldgaard.com eller send os din ansøgning via Ansøg senest 22. oktober 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler og afslutter processen, når den rette kandidat er fundet. Tiltrædelse hurtigst muligt.

title: Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project - Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs
employer: DTU Afdelingen for Uddannelse og Studerende
description:
Would you like to contribute to the development of DTU’s educational offers? Do you want to help shape the future of European higher education and collaborate with colleagues and partners across Europe?

The Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS) at DTU is looking for a proactive Project Manager to join the Office of International Education as Project Manager for the EuroTeQ Pathway Project, a newly awarded 24-month EU-funded project focused on the European Degree Label.

In this role you will help translate new European educational frameworks into practice and support their implementation across DTU, contributing to the continued development and internationalisation of DTU’s educational portfolio.

As Project Manager, you will be at the centre of this work, coordinating partners across Europe while taking responsibility for key training, stakeholder engagement, and implementation activities. Through your work, you will help strengthen DTU’s capacity to engage in new forms of European educational collaboration and turn emerging opportunities into lasting value for DTU and its students.

The job
You will join the Office of International Education, as part of the Office for Study Programmes and Student Affairs (AUS), which has approximately 120 employees and is responsible for developing and supporting DTU’s educational processes, with a strong focus on our students.

As our new Project Manager, you will coordinate the EuroTeQ Pathway Project from planning and reporting, to partner coordination and delivery of key activities.

This is not a conventional project management position. You will also take an active role in developing the project’s content, leading training and stakeholder activities, and strengthening DTU’s understanding of the European Degree Label and its implications in a Danish context. You will work closely with consortium partners and DTU colleagues, while taking responsibility for the quality and delivery of the project activities within your remit.

The role offers an opportunity to combine international project leadership with educational development and stakeholder engagement, while helping translate European developments into value for DTU and its educational portfolio. We anticipate 5-10 travel days a year.

Your main responsibilities will include:
  • Coordinate the overall project plan, including timelines, milestones, budget, risks, and dependencies across the four work packages.
  • Coordinate consortium partners and EU project reporting, ensuring timely delivery of project outputs and milestones
  • Lead the development and implementation of key project activities, including training, communication, and stakeholder events.
  • Organise and facilitate the national stakeholder workshop and contribute to the project’s national roadmap.
  • Build and maintain relationships with national and international stakeholders across higher education, quality assurance, and policy.
  • Strengthen DTU’s institutional understanding of the European Degree Label and translate relevant project outcomes into value for DTU’s educational development.

Knowledge of Danish is not required for the position. However, as much of DTU's internal administration is conducted in Danish, you should expect to encounter Danish in larger meetings and institutional contexts.

Our expectations of you
You have a university degree and, ideally, experience from the education sector or another publicly funded organization, with experience in project management.

We would like you to:
  • Have a proactive and self-driven approach, with a strong sense of ownership. You take initiative, move activities forward independently, and know when to seek input and involve relevant colleagues
  • Seek out effective collaboration and cross-functional coordination
  • Be able to follow and devise formalised processes
  • Are able to familiarise yourself with study regulations and the legal framework in the education sector, for example, Knowledge of European higher education, particularly quality assurance, accreditation, and/or cross-border regulatory frameworks. Familiarity with frameworks such as the European Approach for Quality Assurance of Joint Programmes or EQAR would be an advantage.
  • Experience planning and delivering stakeholder events, from initial concept and logistics through to facilitation, delivery, and follow-up.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international atmosphere with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. We place emphasis on a high level of professionalism among our staff, so skills development is an integral part of our organization. We offer a great flexibility in the position. In the area of technical and natural sciences, DTU is one of the leading research and education institutions in Europe.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations (AC). In addition, supplements can be negotiated in accordance with DTU’s salary structure for academic staff employed in technical-administrative positions at DTU (AC TAP): www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The workplace is DTU Lyngby Campus.

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than Monday, 12 October 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates.

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Director of International Education Morten Overgaard, +45 2112 9850.

For specific questions about the tasks for this role or the broader project, please contact International Programme Manager Paige Daly, +45 2365 2213.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

title: Studentermedhjælper til automatisering og forretningsudvikling
description:
Bliv driftschefens højre hånd hos Holstebro Vægtservice.

Vi har vejet Danmark siden 1977, alt fra fisk til fyldte lastbiler. Nu bygger vi virksomheden op på ny: mere digital, mere struktureret og klar til vækst. 

Til det søger vi en studerende, der vil arbejde tæt sammen med driftschefen om at udvikle forretningen. Vejen fra idé til handling er kort, og ansvaret er større, end studenterjobs normalt byder på. Du er også velkommen til at bruge HOVA som case i dit semesterprojekt, bachelor eller speciale.

Det praktiske

8 til 15 timer om ugen, tilpasset dit semester. Timeløn efter kvalifikationer.

Forventet start hurtigst muligt. Typisk 1 til 2 faste dage i Holstebro, resten aftaler vi, når du kender dit skema. Vi ligger cirka 30 minutter fra Herning ad motorvejen.

Din første opgave

Når du er sat ind i virksomheden, bliver din første opgave at undersøge, hvordan vi kan effektivisere og måske automatisere processen omkring salg af labels til kunder. Herfra er du med til selv at pege på, hvilke processer vi lettest kan effektivisere og få mest værdi ud af.

Opgaverne

  • Udvikle webshop og hjemmeside: oprette produkter, forbedre indhold og skabe mersalg

  • Producere SoMe-indhold, der viser, hvad vi laver

  • Drive igangsatte initiativer helt i mål

  • Undersøge og præsentere processer og struktur, så forretningen kan skalere

  • Teste og bygge automatiseringer med AI, Make eller N8N, og finde ud af, hvad der faktisk virker


I starten fokuserer vi mest på de tre første, men løbende udvikles dit ansvarsområde, som du starter og udvikler dig.

Du kommer også med teknikerne ud til kunderne for at se hvad vi laver og giver en hånd på værkstedet, når fx. ordrer skal pakkes. 

Hvem er du?

  • Du læser fx BDE eller ITKO i Herning, eller noget der ligner

  • Du er nysgerrig og arbejdsom, og du får ting færdige, ikke kun startet

  • Du tør træffe beslutninger og stå på mål for dem

  • Du behøver ikke kunne kode, men AI skal vække din nysgerrighed. Kender du Make eller N8N, er det et plus

  • Du behøver ikke vide noget om vægte. Det kommer.

Det får du

  • Reelt ansvar: egne projekter og direkte samarbejde med driftschefen. Dine beslutninger kan ses i forretningen, ikke i et slidedeck

  • Fleksible timer: timetallet følger dit semester, og der er plads til at skrue ned op til eksamen

  • HOVA som case: brug os i semesterprojekter, bachelor eller speciale

  • Læring på tværs: strategi, drift, salg, marketing og teknik i samme uge

  • En arbejdsplads, ikke kun en skærm: opgaverne løses primært hos os i Holstebro, men fleksibilitet er en nøgleværdi, og vi finder en model, der passer med dit studie

Hvorfor Holstebro Vægtservice?

Vi er et lille team, og i dag en del af VF Stålindustri. Vores kunder spænder fra
fiskeindustri og landbrug til produktion, og fælles for dem er, at intet må veje forkert. Vi står midt i en rigtig spændende periode i virksomhedens historie, og du kan være med til at forme den.

Sådan søger du

Send en motiveret ansøgning og dit CV til tu@hova.dk.
Ring til Tobias på +45 20 23 93 99 hvis du vil hører mere først. 

Vi holder samtaler løbende og ansætter, når den rette er der.

Vi har et højt fagligt output, hvilket vi har oparbejdet i mange år gennem faglig og pædagogisk sparring, medinddragelse på alle niveauer og et fælles ønske om at indgå i meningsfulde fællesskaber, der hver dag drager omsorg for børnenes trivsel og læring i et inkluderende miljø. 

Det professionelle samarbejde er en vigtig del af vores arbejde og afgørende for, at alle elever trives og udvikler sig. Derfor søger vi en matematiklærer, der har lyst til at samarbejde tæt med kollegerne og bidrage aktivt til vores fælles ansvar for børnenes læring og trivsel. Som matematiklærer på 5. årgang får du skemalagt tid til fælles forberedelse med årgangens øvrige matematiklærere. I samarbejdet indgår også en matematikvejleder, så I sammen kan udvikle undervisningen og træffe pædagogiske og didaktiske valg ud fra en fælles faglig tilgang.

Vi arbejder målrettet med at udvikle vores faglige og pædagogiske praksis – både i klassefællesskabet og i mindre fællesskaber på tværs af klasser og årgange. Det er vigtigt for os, at alle elever oplever at have mulighed for at deltage og bidrage i skolens mange fællesskaber. Hos os står ingen alene – hverken børn eller voksne.

Alle lærere er tilknyttet årgangsteams og fagfællesskaber på tværs af hele skolen. Samarbejdet er karakteriseret ved at være tæt, professionelt og nærværende.

Vi vægter, at du kan noget af dét her og hvis du ikke kan det hele, så kan vi resten i fællesskab: 

  • Du tør stå på kanten og gøre dét, der skal til for at eleverne lykkes – også når det ikke er helt efter drejebogen
  • Du er sjov og positiv at være sammen med og kan skabe tillid og tryghed i den nære relation med eleverne, forældrene og kollegaerne
  • Du kan undervise i matematik og er god til at motivere eleverne – også selvom de siger nej tak
  • Du er nysgerrig på praksis - også når en dag ikke går som planlagt
  • Du er selvstændig og kan træffe beslutninger på egen hånd
  • Du bidrager positivt og anerkendende til arbejdsglæden i teamet og på skolen

Vi er udviklingsorienterede og er tidligere blevet tildelt Frederiksberg Kommunes innovationspris for vores fokus på varieret og anderledes undervisning. Vi leder derfor først og fremmest efter medarbejderprofiler, der har lyst til at videreudvikle vores spændende skole. 

Skolen ved Bülowsvej er centralt beliggende på Frederiksberg og har knap 1000 elever fra børnehaveklasse til 9. klasse. Personalet består af mere end 120 medarbejdere, der har stor lyst og vilje til at samarbejde og gå nye veje. Vi har en uhøjtidelig omgangsform, hvor dialog og gensidig tillid er grundlaget for arbejdet. Derudover har vi Frederiksbergs bedste personaleforening, træningscenter for alle medarbejdere og snackbuffet med frugtordning – livet står aldrig stille på Skolen ved Bülowsvej. Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig! 

 

Kontakt gerne skoleleder, Lars Westh på tlf.: 28980591 eller souschef, Sabine Skafte på tlf: 28980594 for at høre nærmere om stillingen, skolen eller noget helt tredje. 

 

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår er i henhold til gældende overenskomst. Vi gør opmærksom på, at der indhentes børneattest og privat straffeattest ved ansættelse i Frederiksberg Kommune.

 

Ansøgningsfristen er onsdag den 4. november kl. 12.00 og ansættelsessamtaler afholdes fredag den 6. november 2026. 

Vi gør opmærksom på, at vi løbende indkalder relevante ansøgere. Ansøgning foregår via linket. 

 

Venlig hilsen 

Lars Westh/skoleleder 

 


Frederiksberg er en levende by med et dynamisk bysamfund. Byens sjæl bygger på vores historie og klassiske arv og er med til at præge den spændende udvikling af Frederiksberg som en grøn, sund og pulserende del af Hovedstaden.
Vi er en moderne kommune, der betjener 104.305 borgere. Frederiksberg Kommune ønsker at fremme ligestillingen og opfordrer derfor alle kvalificerede til at søge uanset alder, handicap, race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse.

title: Specialist/Consultant in Neurology looking for job opportunities in Denmark
description:
Newly Created Position at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital for an Emergency Neurology Profile in Partnership with Rigshospitalet, The University Hospital of Copenhagen.

We are expanding our team of specialists at Mid- and West Zealand Hospital, Denmark as we develop a new emergency neurology profile. You will have a direct professional influence on our future emergency services and become part of a new, close partnership with Rigshospitalet.

Why choose us?

Help shape the emergency services of the future: You will play a central role in developing and launching our upcoming emergency neurology profile (without a thrombolysis service).
New partnership with Rigshospitalet: The collaboration will open opportunities for professional exchange, knowledge sharing and research. For those interested, there will also be opportunities for attractive split appointments (e.g. one day per week at Rigshospitalet).
New professional opportunities from 1 January 2027: As a result of the healthcare reform in Denmark, we will take over specialised rehabilitation from the municipalities, creating exciting opportunities for professional development.
Scope for your subspecialty: Whether your interests lie in MS, movement disorders, headache, dementia, epilepsy or rehabilitation, we will adapt the framework to allow you to pursue your area of expertise.
A strong research environment: We focus on patients with multimorbidity and have our own Professor of Neurology. Research is primarily focused on multiple sclerosis.
Your profile

You are a specialist/consultant in neurology, whether you are newly qualified and eager to develop your skills or an experienced colleague looking for a new professional setting.

We imagine that you:

Are passionate about multidisciplinary collaboration and want to help shape the quality of the new emergency setup.
Value a strong professional network across hospitals.
Appreciate the opportunity to provide clinical guidance and supervision to our junior doctors.
Are decisive, flexible and actively contribute to our positive working environment and pioneering spirit.

Your working day and responsibilities

Our department provides primary-level neurological services in the hospital at Slagelse (inpatient ward for phase II rehabilitation, primarily for apoplexy cases, as well as specialist clinics), and in the hospital of Naestved, where we run the Centre for Neurorehabilitation (CNN), which provides services at regional level.

Your responsibilities will include:

Working in our outpatient department, specialist clinics or the interdisciplinary Memory Clinic, in collaboration with geriatricians, psychiatrists and neuropsychologists.
Supervising junior doctors and participating in the multidisciplinary environment across our hospital sites.
On-call duties: Our consultants currently cover the senior on-call function on site until 9.00 pm, followed by an on-call-from-home arrangement (there is junior on-call doctor is present on site around the clock).
About the department

Neurology is part of a combined department (Medicine 3 and Department of Physio- and Occupational Therapy) that works closely and efficiently alongside the Department of Geriatrics. We place a strong emphasis on professional dialogue and peer support within a group of doctors characterised by strong collegial relationships and a shared desire to develop the specialty.

Mid- and West Zealand Hospital is located around 60 min. by car from central Copenhagen.

Practical information and application

The seven medical roles: Your application should address the seven medical competencies specifically, supported by the best possible documentation.
Interests: If you have specific wishes regarding subspecialisation or are interested in a split appointment with Rigshospitalet, we would be pleased if you mention this in your application.

Relocation Assistance and Danish Language Tutoring

When you relocate to Denmark in connection with your employment, we offer free, professional assistance with relocation and settling in, either close to the hospital or anywhere on Zealand you might prefer. You will receive help with everything from finding accommodation to registration and arrangements for any accompanying family members.

An important part of working as a doctor in Denmark is communication between you and your patients and colleagues. For patient safety reasons, Region Zealand therefore requires our doctors to have a satisfactory level of Danish language proficiency. We therefore provide a language teacher for one-to-one tuition, enabling you to communicate with your patients as quickly as possible at a level where you can understand one another.

This means, that we expect you to be prepared to devote time to learning Danish, both spoken and written as part of your employment.

Find out more about what kind of assistance we offer, as well as watch interviews with other doctors that have relocated to Region Zealand at www.medicaljobsdenmark.com.

Would you like to know more?

You are very welcome to contact Chief Physician Benedikte Wanscher on mobile +45 93 57 62 51 or by email at bewa@regionsjaelland.dk for an informal and confidential conversation about the position.

Please upload your application and CV as soon as possible. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis.

title: Forskningsprojekt Arven i Landskabet
description:
Museum Odense søger en postdoc til en etårig stilling i forskningsprojektet Arven i Landskabet.

Forskningsprojektet

Det danske landskab står over for nogle af de største forandringer i nyere tid. Med Den Grønne Trepart og en række andre natur-, klima- og miljøtiltag skal store arealer i de kommende år ændre anvendelse. Landbrug, natur, biodiversitet, klima og lokale interesser skal finde nye balancer. Men det er ikke første gang, det danske landskab gennemgår en grundlæggende omstilling.

Arven i Landskabet undersøger det store brud i det danske landskabs udvikling ca. 1780-1914. I løbet af denne periode blev et varieret og mange steder ekstensivt udnyttet kulturlandskab forandret til et stadig mere intensivt landbrugslandskab. Gennem analyser af blandt andet historiske kort, nationale data og lokale kilder undersøger projektet, hvad der drev forandringerne, hvordan de udspillede sig forskelligt fra sted til sted, og hvilken betydning landskabets fysiske rammer, teknologiske muligheder, økonomiske interesser og menneskers valg havde.

Projektet stopper imidlertid ikke i 1914. Et centralt mål er at bringe den historiske viden i spil i den aktuelle grønne omstilling. Hvad kan tidligere tiders gennemgribende landskabsforandringer fortælle os om de processer, konflikter og muligheder, der præger omstillingen i dag? Og hvordan kan et langt historisk perspektiv kvalificere vores forståelse af de valg, der nu træffes om fremtidens landskab?

Projektet er støttet af Augustinus Fonden 2026-2029 og placeret på Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum. Din arbejdsplads bliver på Museum Odense. Læs mere på https://museumodense.dk/forskningsartikler/arven-i-landskabet/.

Stillingen

Som postdoc får du en central rolle i den del af Arven i Landskabet, der forbinder projektets historiske undersøgelser med de landskabsforandringer, der finder sted i Danmark netop nu.

En væsentlig opgave bliver at undersøge, hvordan nutidens landmænd, lodsejere og andre lokale aktører oplever og forholder sig til den grønne omstilling og til konkrete forandringer i det landskab, de lever og arbejder i. Det gælder blandt andet processer og naturprojekter knyttet til Den Grønne Trepart. Gennem kvalitative interviews og, hvor det er relevant, surveys og andre analyser skal du undersøge aktørernes perspektiver, handlemuligheder og interesser samt de muligheder og konflikter, der opstår, når hensyn til landbrugsproduktion, klima, biodiversitet, natur og lokalsamfund mødes.

Undersøgelserne skal sættes i relation til projektets historiske forskning. Du kommer dermed til at arbejde med spørgsmål som: Hvordan gennemføres store landskabsforandringer lokalt? Hvad får mennesker til at medvirke til, modsætte sig eller forsøge at påvirke dem? Hvilken betydning har erfaringer, ejerskab, økonomi, natursyn og tilknytning til landskabet? Og hvad kan erfaringerne fra tidligere perioder med omfattende landskabsforandringer bidrage med til de beslutninger, vi træffer i dag?

Opgaven har således en klar ramme, men der er samtidig betydeligt forskningsmæssigt råderum. Afhængigt af din faglige profil og dine interesser får du mulighed for at præge undersøgelsens forskningsspørgsmål, teoretiske perspektiv, metode og konkrete empiriske fokus inden for projektets overordnede problemstillinger.

Du bliver en del af en tværfaglig forskningsgruppe på tværs af Museum Odense, Aarhus Universitet og Det Grønne Museum og vil arbejde tæt sammen med projektets øvrige forskere. Stillingen indebærer både selvstændigt forskningsarbejde og deltagelse i projektets fælles aktiviteter. Du forventes blandt andet at bidrage til projektets dataindsamling og analyser, videnskabelige publikationer, den afsluttende antologi og et fagligt symposium samt til formidling af forskningen til en bredere offentlighed og den aktuelle debat om fremtidens landskab.

Kompetencer

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har en ph.d.-grad eller tilsvarende inden for f.eks. etnologi, antropologi, historie eller tilsvarende relevante fag.
  • Har erfaring med interviews til forskningsundersøgelser.
  • Har interesse for landskabsforskning og -forvaltning.
  • Kan arbejde selvstændigt og struktureret.
  • Har kørekort B, da der kan forventes kørsel i arbejdstiden. 

Vi tilbyder

  • Et tværfagligt og spændende forskningsmiljø, heriblandt fire andre forskere ved Arven i Landskabet i Odense.
  • Deltagelse i den større tværfaglige projektgruppe med forskere på Aarhus Universitet, Det Grønne Museum og Museum Odense (heriblandt Den Fynske Landsby).
  • En kombination af klart definerede projektopgaver og forskningsmæssigt råderum til at udvikle egne spørgsmål og analyser inden for projektets ramme.

Ansøgning og ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningen skal indeholde:

  • En motiveret ansøgning (maks. 2 sider), hvor du redegør for:
    • din motivation for at søge stillingen
    • dine kvalifikationer i forhold til opslaget
    • en kort beskrivelse af, hvordan du vil tilgå projektet forskningsmæssigt
  • CV (maks. 2 sider)
  • En kopi af kandidatbevis og evt. ph.d.-bevis
  • Publikationsliste med angivelse af de vedhæftede publikationer, som ønskes taget i betragtning ved bedømmelsen
  • Maksimalt 2 vedhæftede publikationer til bedømmelse.
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 15. nov. 2026

Vi anvender shortlisting, hvor et antal ansøgere udvælges til bedømmelse af deres faglige kvalifikationer. På baggrund af bedømmelserne indkaldes en eller flere kandidater til samtale. De ansøgere, hvis ansøgning ikke sendes til bedømmelse, orienteres om dette umiddelbart efter shortlisting. Samtaler foretages i midten af december. Endeligt afslag sendes ved afslutningen af rekrutteringen.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes i henhold til gældende forhandlingsberettigede overenskomst. Stillingen er på 37 timer om ugen i 12 måneder. Det primære arbejdssted er Forskningscenter CENTRUM ved Museum Odense og det forventes, at du som udgangspunkt er til stede på museet i arbejdstiden. Der vil dog forekomme feltarbejde, seminarer og projektmøder andre steder.

Tiltrædelse 1. feb. 2027 eller snarest derefter.

Uddybende spørgsmål om stillingen kan rettes til projektleder ved Arven i Landskabet Peder Dam tlf. 21493464 og mail pda@museumodense.dk.

Museum Odense er en selvejende institution og et af landets store statsanerkendte kulturhistoriske museer. Vi driver i alt seks museer og havde i 2025 et samlet besøgstal på over 400.000. Museets Vision 2026 og Strategi 2024-2026 sætter rammer og retning for museets ambitiøse udvikling i de kommende år. Se museets vision og strategi på Organisation - Museum Odense Museum-Odense_kort-strategi-2024-2026.pdf

Alle gældende regler om håndtering af persondata og fortrolighed overholdes i den forbindelse.

title: Experienced Data Engineer Consultant
description:
Experienced Data Engineer Consultant

  • Kampmannsgade 2, 1604 København, Denmark

  • Full-time

  • Contract type: Permanent contract

Job Description

Are you an experienced Data Engineer ready for your next challenge? Would you like to lead technical architecture, mentor junior talent, and work directly with clients while staying at the forefront of modern data technologies? Then read on and apply to join our dynamic young team of 50 data experts who help companies gain new insights using a wide palette of modern tools. 

  • Contract: Full-time 

  • Location: Central Copenhagen, near Vesterport Station

Work Assignments

As an Experienced Data Engineer, you will operate at the intersection of deep technical expertise and business advisory. You will be responsible for:

  • Technical Design & Development: Designing and developing modern data solutions, ensuring our team implements the highest standards of data engineering.

  • Advisory & Collaboration: Acting as a trusted partner for our clients’ decision makers, ensuring good collaboration with their engineers, analysts, & business users.

  • Mentorship & Growth: Elevating our team of less experienced engineers through mentoring and fostering a culture of continuous technical improvement.

You will collaborate with our experienced data engineers, while quickly taking a mentoring role for our many less experienced consultants. 

What You Bring to the Team

Ideally, you have:

  • Solid experience working as a Data Engineer. 

  • Proficiency in Python, SQL, or APIs. 

  • Previous experience with some of these technologies: Snowflake, Databricks, Fabric, dbt, Azure, AWS, or GCP. 

  • An analytical approach to problem-solving, with a strong interest in how to drive business improvement using data.

  • Clear communication skills and the curiosity to engage with clients on projects.

  • A relevant degree.

  • A base near Copenhagen and fluency in English.

If you're excited about this role but you don’t tick all the boxes, we still encourage you to apply.

Why Devoteam Data Driven?

You will join a fantastic team of talented, curious data experts in a collaborative and dynamic workplace. Beyond working with nice colleagues on impactful projects, we offer comprehensive benefits to support your growth:

  • Continuous Growth & Community: We invest in your talent and dedicate time for learning to ensure you have up-to-date certifications in our technologies.

  • Work-Life Balance: We prioritize your personal time. In addition to your six weeks of paid vacation, we offer the flexibility of taking unlimited unpaid time off.

  • Social Events: We offer a variety of social events throughout the year. Recently we have done Lasertag, Pottery, Disc Golf, Book Club, Curling, Board Game Night, Foosball Tournament, Ice Hockey, among many other things.

Our Impact

Below are a few examples of our work:

  • Migrated Novo's global supply chain analytics solution from Alteryx-based workflows to a governed, cloud-native architecture using dbt, Snowflake, and Azure DevOps to support enterprise-scale analytics and collaboration.

  • Developed a comprehensive end-to-end data warehouse solution, featuring automated pipelines that structured dimensional data from diverse operational systems for unified analytics for a client.

  • Assessed the current data landscape in Novonesis and implemented a new self-service framework to enable business users to utilise the power of the modern data stack.

Application Process

Apply by uploading your CV no later than October 18th.

We review applications and invite selected candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. 

We encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, or disability.

About Devoteam

Devoteam is a leading digital consultancy represented in 25 countries in Europe with +11,000 employees. In Denmark, our team is around 350 people and spread across four business teams - Data Driven (our team), a ServiceNow team, a Digital Management Consultancy team & a Google Cloud team - each focused on different aspects of digital transformation.

title: Postdoc positions within Robotics for Laboratory Automation
description:
SDU Robotics is currently extending the team within the project CAPeX which focuses on robotics for laboratory automation. We therefore invite applications for one or more fully funded postdoc positions. The position is for a 2-year period with a starting date January 1, 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter. The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

 

What we offer

  • An exciting opportunity to work at the cutting edge of robotics for real-world applications.

  • A collaborative and supportive work environment that encourages innovation and creativity.

  • Opportunities for professional growth and leadership.

  • Access to state-of-the-art technology and resources.

  • An opportunity to collaborate with excellent researchers within the Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery

 

Job description

SDU Robotics currently has an open 2-year postdoc position in relation to CAPeX; specifically, for the development of a robotic solution for automation of laboratory experiments that require manipulation of tubes, fragile glass vials, and liquids. The robotic solution should be flexible in the sense that it should be able to conduct several experiments with little user-intervention, operate alongside humans, and recover from failures. Consequently, visual feedback must be used for adapting robot behavior to a dynamic environment.  The postdoc should contribute to the deployment of the developed solution in laboratories in both SDU and DTU. The successful candidate will work closely with other PhDs and postdoc candidates in CAPeX.

As a postdoctoral researcher, your role will encompass mainly research, but teaching responsibilities could also be part of the employment. The main duties and responsibilities include: 

  • Research in collaboration with colleagues from SDU Robotics and CAPeX.

  • Conducting scientific research and publishing the results in high quality scientific conferences/journals.

  • Supporting the team in securing external funding.

  • Contributing to the project CAPeX deliverables. 

 

Profile and requirements

The position requires research experience at PhD level in a relevant area such as robotics, preferably applied to robotic systems controlled using visual feedback. The candidate is hence expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Expert knowledge in the control of robots

  • Experience in simulation of robotic systems

  • Experience in design and development of robotic systems

  • Experience with using computer vision.

Furthermore, the successful candidate is expected to:

  • Have excellent knowledge of English (written and spoken).

  • Be able to work well and communicate expert knowledge in an interdisciplinary team.

  • Have the ability of working independently.

  • Have a strong sense of responsibility.

  • Conduct independent research. 

 

Research environment

The candidate will be integrated into the SDU Robotics unit, which is a team of approx. 60 employees. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team with flexible work organization and support for individual development.

SDU Robotics is part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, University of Southern Denmark (SDU), and located at the main Campus in Odense, at the core of the Odense Robotics Cluster involving 120+ startups and established companies in robotics. The group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners.

We are a team specialized in robot solutions involving modelling, estimation, and control of advanced robot systems. In addition, the candidate will be integrated into CAPeX - a pioneer center for accelerating P2X materials discovery and working on automation of laboratory experiments.

CAPeX is a 13-year and 300 MDKK “Pioneer Center for Accelerating P2X Materials Discovery”, funded by Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science, the Danish National Research Foundation, the Carlsberg Foundation, the Lundbeck Foundation, the Novo Nordisk Foundation, and the Villum Foundation. CAPeX is hosted by the Technical University of Denmark (DTU) and co-hosted by Aalborg University (AAU), and unites leading experts from DTU, AAU, University of Copenhagen, Aarhus University, and the University of Southern Denmark with international partners from Stanford University, Utrecht University, and the University of Toronto to form a truly Pioneering Center on P2X. You can read more about the CAPeX research themes and X-trails, our organization, and the other open PhD and postdoc cohort positions at http://www.capex-p2x.com. 

We look forward to receiving your application and to supporting your academic growth as a researcher in SDU Robotics. 

 

Further information 

Further information about this position is available via email from Professor Christoffer Sloth chsl@mmmi.sdu.dk.

Please visit us on LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/sdu-robotics. 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

Further information for international applicants about entering and working in Denmark. You may also visit WorkinDenmark for additional information.

Further information about The Faculty of Engineering.

 

Application

Applicants are advised to read the SDU information on how to apply.

The application deadline is October 28, 2026, at 11:59 PM/23:59 (CET/CEST) 

 

Employment as a postdoc requires scientific qualifications at PhD level at the time of employment.

Assessment of the candidates is based on the application material, and the application must include:

  • A motivation letter that clearly explains the applicant's interest, qualifications, and motivation for the position (max. 2 pages).

  • Detailed Curriculum Vitae, including personal contact information. 

  • Master’s and PhD degree certificates or equivalent (original and an official English translation).  

  • List of publications and maximum 2 examples of relevant publications.

The application may also include: 

  • Research statement. 

  • Summary of experience in teaching. 

  • References (names and emails) and/or reference letters.

  • Documentation of other qualifications with relevance for the position. 

All documents must be in English and PDF format. CPR number (civil registration number) must be crossed out. All PDF-files must be unlocked, allow binding and may not be password protected. 

SUBMISSION GUIDE: Motivated application must be uploaded under ‘Cover letter’ (max. 5 MB), Curriculum Vitae must be uploaded under ‘Resume’ (max 5 MB). All other documents must be uploaded under ‘Miscellaneous documents’ (max 10 files with a maximum 50 MB per file). 

If you experience technical problems, please contact our email support.

The University of Southern Denmark wishes to reflect the surrounding community and therefore encourages everyone, regardless of personal background, to apply for the position.

SDU conducts research in critical technologies, which, due to the risk of unwanted knowledge transfer, are subject to a number of security measures. Therefore, based on information from open sources, background checks may be conducted on candidates for the position.

 

Assessment and selection process

Applications will be assessed by an expert or assessment committee. Shortlisting may be applied, and only shortlisted candidates will receive a written assessment. Read about shortlisting at SDU.  Interviews and tests may be part of the overall evaluation.

Read about the Assessment and selection process.  

 

Employment terms

Appointment as a postdoc is temporary for an initial 2-year period, and the preferred start date is from January 1, 2026. Extension may be possible depending on available funding (no more than 4 years at the same university).

The workplace is at SDU's main campus in Odense, Denmark, and the work is expected to be primarily onsite.

Research will be predominant in the position. Teaching assignments can be agreed individually. Furthermore, other types of assignments may occur to a limited degree. The faculty determines the distribution of the various assignments. The weighting of the different assignments may vary over time.

Employment will be in accordance with the collective agreement between the Ministry of Finance and the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations for academics in the state including the associated circular on the protocol for the job structure for academic staff at Danish universities and the provisions for postdoc as described therein. 

Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements. As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process. SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary. Further information on salary and taxation. 

Persons employed in the position may, based on a specific individual managerial assessment, be exempted from time registration, also known as a “self-organizer”.

title: Industrielektriker søges til stærkt team i Vestjylland
description:
Har du lyst til at arbejde med installationsopgaver hos nogle af Danmarks største industrivirksomheder? Og sætter du en ære i at levere solidt håndværk, hvor kvalitet og samarbejde er i fokus? Så kan du blive en del af vores voksende industriafdeling hos Viftrup Jespersen A/S.

Et arbejde med mening og ansvar

Vi har travlt og udvider derfor teamet i vores industriafdeling. Her arbejder vi tæt sammen med store fødevareproducenter og leverer tekniske løsninger, der holder produktionen i gang. Det kræver faglighed og ansvarlighed – og det er netop dét, vi leder efter.

Du får din daglige base i Videbæk og bliver en del af et stærkt hold, hvor samarbejde, ordentlighed og godt håndværk går hånd i hånd. Dine opgaver vil primært være hos én af vores største industrikunder.

”Hos os får du mere indflydelse på dine opgaver og en tættere relation til både kolleger og ledelse, end du finder mange andre steder.”
– Anders Elkjær, ejer

Dine arbejdsopgaver

Som en del af industriafdelingen vil du arbejde med:

  • Installation og montage af el-tekniske løsninger

  • Opsætning af føringsveje og kabelføring

  • Automationsopgaver og mindre styretavlearbejde

  • Servicering og vedligehold af installationer

  • Deltagelse i både projekter og løbende drift

Du vil samarbejde med både vores egne teknikere og kundens projektledere. Vi sørger for grundig oplæring og introduktion til opgaver og arbejdsgange.

Faglig udvikling og et stærkt fællesskab

Hos os er der plads til at udvikle sig. Vi starter dig op med mindre opgaver og bygger gradvist på, i takt med at du bliver fortrolig med arbejdsgangene. Har du ambitioner, støtter vi gerne op med relevante kurser og efteruddannelse.

Vi er et team, der hjælper hinanden – både fagligt og socialt. Vores personaleforening arrangerer jævnligt aktiviteter, og vi prioriterer et arbejdsmiljø, hvor alle trives.

Hvad vi forventer af dig

Vi leder efter en kollega, som:

  • er fagligt stærk og arbejder med kvalitet og struktur

  • er mødestabil og ansvarsbevidst

  • har lyst til at samarbejde og tage ejerskab i opgaverne

Du har sandsynligvis en baggrund som elektriker, industrielektriker eller automatiktekniker – og gerne erfaring med industriinstallationer.

Det får du hos os

Udover spændende opgaver og et godt fællesskab tilbyder vi:

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer

  • Fastansættelse i en stabil virksomhed

  • Overenskomst, pension og sundhedsforsikring

  • Lokale goder som fx rabat på fitness og svømmehal

  • Mulighed for efteruddannelse

 

Interesseret?

Er du klar til at tage ansvar for, at vi lever op til vores kunders høje forventninger? Så send CV og ansøgning til Jette på jcl@viftrup.dk Vi vurderer kandidater og indkalder til samtaler løbende. Vi ansætter, når vi har fundet den rette kandidat, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Vil du vide mere om dit nye job, så er du meget velkommen til at kontakte os på jcl@viftrup.dk eller 51200268.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

title: Chef / Cook – Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar, Kalundborg
description:
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar is looking for skilled and motivated Chefs / Cooks to join our established restaurant in Kalundborg, Denmark.

Our restaurant in Kalundborg is a well-run, busy operation with a proven concept, experienced ownership and a clear direction. Located right in the middle of Kalundborg's main pedestrian street, we are a lively, pulsing part of the town and a gathering place for its residents. Our purpose is to create a vibrant place for the people of Kalundborg, built on quality ingredients and good food. We are now strengthening our kitchen team and are looking for chefs who want to become part of a structured, professional kitchen and contribute to consistent, high-quality service every day.

Our concept is based on modern Danish cuisine with a Nordic twist, combined with well executed brasserie classics and a varied à la carte menu. We focus on quality ingredients, solid craftsmanship and seasonal cooking, with dishes that combine flavour, comfort and consistency. Our menu includes both classic meat dishes, such as pepper steak, pasta dishes and other popular brasserie favourites.

Alongside our à la carte service, we have a private dining and events room, which you will also be part of. It brings welcome variety to the daily kitchen work, with menus that differ from the standard à la carte and the chance to cook for parties, celebrations and special occasions.

You will be joining a business with an already proven concept, an organised kitchen and a strong operational foundation. The setup is stable and well prepared, giving you a secure framework in which to do great work and develop your craft. Here you also get the freedom to bring your own ideas to life. We are not a place where everything is dictated from above — our chefs and kitchen staff are given the room to develop dishes, contribute to the menu and put their own mark on the food.

We are a serious but friendly workplace with respectful leadership, an organised kitchen environment and a no-drama culture. We believe strong kitchens are built on structure, teamwork and professionalism.

We are looking for chefs / cooks who:
• Have experience working in a professional kitchen
• Can handle prep, mise en place and service in a structured way
• Have experience with à la carte service
• Care about quality, teamwork and consistency
• Thrive in a busy restaurant environment
• Can work independently and take responsibility during service

We offer:
• Full-time employment
• A fixed work schedule
• Weekend work is part of the position
• Salary of approximately DKK 30,000–35,000 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience
• Five weeks of paid holiday
• Company apartment / accommodation available
• Help with relocation and settling in Denmark
• Possibility of support with moving costs and/or paid accommodation in the first month, by agreement
• Good working conditions in a structured and professional environment
• Staff meals
• Work clothing provided
• Staff discounts
• A stable, established restaurant with a proven concept and an organised kitchen
• The freedom to develop your own ideas and contribute to the menu
• A workplace where English can be used in daily communication

Location
The position is based in Kalundborg, Denmark, in the heart of the city's main pedestrian street. Kalundborg offers a local Danish atmosphere, a charming town centre and a good quality of life.

Language
English is required. Danish is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Start date
As soon as possible / by agreement.

How to apply
Please send
• Your CV
• A short introduction about yourself
• Your earliest possible start date

For applications and questions, please contact:
Esbern Snare ApS
Esbern Snare Brasserie & Cocktail Bar
Phone: +45 25 14 44 00
Email: job@esbern-snare.dk

We look forward to hearing from motivated chefs who want to become part of a strong, established kitchen team in Denmark.

Please note that you must already have the right to work in Denmark, either as an EU/EEA or Swiss citizen or by holding a valid Danish work permit that allows you to take this position.

title: Chef to join our international kitchen team
description:
CHEF WANTED FOR STAFF RESTAURANT IN COPENHAGEN, DENMARK

Looking for a chef position in Copenhagen with great working hours, professional cooking and weekends mostly free?

We are looking for a skilled and motivated chef to join our international kitchen team in Copenhagen, Denmark.

Your main workplace will be The Staff Restaurant at Abacus Medicine, located at Kalvebod Brygge in central Copenhagen.

This is a full-time position with working hours primarily Monday to Friday from 06:30 to 14:30 – giving you the opportunity to work in an ambitious professional kitchen while still having your afternoons, evenings and most weekends free.

Occasional evening and weekend events may occur.

THE JOB

You will become part of a professional kitchen team responsible for the daily production and service at our staff restaurant.

We cook from scratch and care about good ingredients, seasonality, flavour and proper craftsmanship.

You will work primarily with hot kitchen production and take responsibility for your own preparation and tasks while working closely with the rest of the team.

Our kitchen is busy, so we are looking for someone who works efficiently and in an organised manner without compromising quality.

Just as importantly, we are looking for a good colleague.

We believe a professional kitchen should be a place where people communicate respectfully, help each other and enjoy coming to work.

WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

You may already be living in Denmark, or you may be considering moving to Copenhagen from another EU/EEA country.

We would like to hear from you if you:

  • are a trained chef or have equivalent professional kitchen experience

  • have experience from à la carte restaurants, quality staff restaurants, hotels or similar professional kitchens

  • have solid experience in the hot kitchen

  • have a genuine interest in food, ingredients and good craftsmanship

  • can organise your own work and maintain a good pace throughout the day

  • are reliable and comfortable starting work early

  • enjoy working as part of a team

  • communicate in a positive and respectful way

  • can maintain an overview when the kitchen gets busy.

A background in classic French or Mediterranean cuisine would be particularly relevant to our kitchen.

However, we are also interested in chefs who bring their own culinary background and experience. Whether your inspiration comes from France, Spain, Italy, Portugal, Greece, North or South America, Asia or somewhere else, we would like to see what you can bring to the team.

We want to taste what you are passionate about.

WHAT WE OFFER

We offer a full-time chef position in central Copenhagen with a working schedule that is unusual in the restaurant industry:

Monday–Friday
Primarily 06:30–14:30
Most evenings and weekends free

You will join a friendly and international workplace with experienced colleagues, high professional standards and room to contribute your own knowledge and ideas.

We value professional pride, teamwork, reliability and a positive working environment.

Our goal is simple: good food, good ingredients, good craftsmanship and a kitchen team that works well together.

MORE THAN A STAFF RESTAURANT
