title: Sales Manager (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Recruiting (Account-Manager/in)
description:
Sales Manager (m/w/d) - Schwerpunkt Recruiting

-In Vollzeit-

Du hast Freude am Vertrieb und möchtest Unternehmen mit passenden Lösungen überzeugen?

Dann werde Teil von AUBI-plus. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, betreust deinen eigenen Kundenstamm und berätst Ausbildungsbetriebe zu unseren Dienstleistungen rund um Ausbildung und Azubi-Gewinnung. Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung für deine Vertriebsziele und baust langfristige Kundenbeziehungen auf.

Deine Aufgaben

- Du gewinnst aktiv neue Kunden und entwickelst qualifizierte Leads zu langfristigen Geschäftspartnern.
- Du betreust deinen eigenen Kundenstamm eigenverantwortlich und baust bestehende Kundenbeziehungen kontinuierlich aus.
- Du verantwortest den gesamten Vertriebsprozess: von der Erstansprache über die Angebotserstellung und Preisverhandlung bis zum erfolgreichen Vertragsabschluss.
- Du berätst Unternehmen ganzheitlich zu den Themen: - Gewinnung von Auszubildenden
- Ausbildungsqualität
- Qualifizierung des Ausbildungspersonals
- Du erkennst vertriebliche Potenziale im Kundenbestand und entwickelst individuelle Lösungen.
- Du kommunizierst in deiner Vertriebstätigkeit telefonisch, per E-Mail, per Webmeeting und Face-to-Face beim Kunden.
- Du behältst deine vertrieblichen Ziele und Aktivitäten stets im Blick und dokumentierst diese im CRM-System.
- Du repräsentierst AUBI-plus auf Messen und Veranstaltungen.

Das bringst du mit

- Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
- Sales-Kompetenzen - insbesondere Verhandlungsgeschick u. Abschlussorientierung in der aktiven Neukundengewinnung.
- Freude daran, Kunden zu begeistern und nachhaltige Beziehungen aufzubauen, zu pflegen und weiterzuentwickeln.
- Strukturierte, eigenständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise.
- Motivation, vertriebliche Ziele zu erreichen und dich kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.
- Ein Plus, aber kein Muss sind theoretische und/oder praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich der beruflichen Ausbildung.

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

Vertrieb mit Sinn

Mit deinem Wirken unterstützt du Unternehmen dabei, ihre Ausbildungsplätze zu besetzen und hilfst gleichzeitig jungen Menschen dabei, top Ausbildungsunternehmen zu finden.

Strukturierte Einarbeitung

Wir machen dich fit für unsere Produkte, Prozesse und deine Vertriebsaufgaben. Freu dich auf eine strukturierte und individuelle Einarbeitung, bei der du nebenbei deine neuen Kollegen kennenlernst.

Leistung lohnt sich

Neben einer attraktiven Vergütung erwartet dich eine leistungsbezogene Prämie. Gute Ergebnisse zahlen sich für dich aus.

Unternehmenskultur

- Flache Hierarchien
- Kurze Entscheidungswege
- Offene Unternehmenskultur

Weitere Benefits

- Flexible Arbeitszeiten
- Ergonomische Arbeitsplätze
- Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge
- Vermögenswirksame Leistungen
- Fahrradleasing mit JobBike
- Attraktive Rabatte mit Corporate Benefits
- Flexibel trainieren mit Sportnavi
- Regelmäßige Team-Events

Klingt das nach einer Aufgabe für dich?

Du hältst unseren Anwält:innen und Partner:innen den Rücken frei – damit sie sich voll auf die juristische Arbeit konzentrieren können, weil Organisation und Prozesse bei dir in den besten Händen sind. - professionelle Unterstützung der anwaltlichen Teams im Tagesgeschäft in nationalen und internationalen wirtschaftsrechtlichen Mandaten
- eigenständige Berechnung, Notierung und Überwachung von Fristen und Terminen

At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. Together, we will build on our company's long history and keep on leading the way to a better world
Discover your exciting role

We are currently looking for a Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) for our Headquarters in Stuttgart / Germany.
The Senior Expert Global Compensation & Benefits (m/f/d) is responsible for supporting the Vice President Compensation & Benefits and Mobility in designing, managing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving compensation and benefits programs to align across Exyte's global organization with the Global strategy. The role develops scalable, market-competitive, and compliant solutions that balance global consistency with local market and regulatory requirements. Working globally, this position partners with HR, Finance, Legal, business leaders, and external advisors to strengthen global job architecture, pay structures, incentive programs, benefits governance, and annual reward processes that support attraction, retention, engagement, and internal equity.

Explore your tasks and responsibilities

- Global Reward Strategy & Program Design: Partner with the VP Compensation, Benefits & Global Mobility to develop and implement global compensation and benefits strategies, frameworks, and governance models that balance enterprise-wide consistency with local market, legal, and business requirements.
- Global Process Ownership & Execution: Lead and optimize global compensation and benefits processes, including annual salary reviews, bonus planning, pay decisions, budgeting, and benefits harmonization across multiple countries and regions.
- Global Analytics, Benchmarking & Technology: Drive global market benchmarking, reward analytics, pay equity assessments, workforce cost forecasting, and data-driven reporting to support strategic reward and workforce decisions.
- Governance, Compliance & Risk Management: Establish and maintain robust global compensation and benefits policies, governance structures, and compliance frameworks while ensuring adherence to evolving regulatory and reporting requirements.
- Global Stakeholder Advisory & Change Enablement: Serve as a trusted advisor to HR, Finance, Legal, Talent Acquisition, and business leaders, leading global change initiatives, policy transformations, and reward program implementations.
- Vendor & External Partner Management: Own the global vendor strategy for Compensation & Benefits, including provider selection, contract management, service quality oversight, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Global Scope: Operate effectively across international regions, cultures, and time zones, fostering collaboration within a global environment and supporting business needs through occasional international travel.
- Program & Project Leadership: Lead complex global reward projects, including M&A integrations, job architecture initiatives, compensation technology implementations, pay transparency programs, benefits harmonization, and organizational change activities.

Show your expertise

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Finance, or a related field.
- Multiple years of professional experience, including significant experience in global or multi-country compensation and benefits roles
- Deep expertise in global compensation and benefits strategy, job architecture, market benchmarking, salary structures, incentive design, and annual reward processes.
- Strong knowledge of global governance and the ability to translate enterprise principles into practical, locally compliant solutions.

description:

Die Position umfasst die Steuerung des täglichen Betriebs und stellt gleichzeitig die Einhaltung der EHS-Vorschriften, Qualitätsstandards, gesetzlichen Anforderungen und Unternehmensrichtlinien sicher. Der Site Manager führt das Standortteam und treibt die kontinuierliche Verbesserung in den Bereichen Produktion, Qualität, Kosten und operative Leistungsfähigkeit voran.

Verantwortlichkeiten:

- Abstimmung der Produktionskapazitäten und Personalplanung mit den Anforderungen der Logistik.
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Anforderungen und Ziele gemäß ISO 9001, ISO 14001 und ISO 50001.
- Verbesserung von Qualität, Ausbeute, Durchsatz, Anlagenverfügbarkeit und Kosten durch kontinuierliche Verbesserungsmaßnahmen und OPEX-Projekte.
- Identifizierung von Investitionsmöglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Anlageneffizienz und Ausbeute.

- 1–3+ years of hands-on experience in HR Operations or People Operations, managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes in a fast-paced environment.
- Solid understanding of German labor law, social security regulations, and general HR administrative compliance.
- Strong proficiency with modern HR systems, particularly Workday and ticketing platforms like Jira or ServiceNow.
- A customer-centric, empathetic mindset with a strong focus on high-quality service delivery.
- Strong detail orientation, problem-solving skills, and ability to prioritize in a dynamic workflow.

title: Conducteur / Conductrice de machines automatiques en montage-asse (H/F)
description:
Kronimus - leader du marché avec ses produits en béton fonctionnels et design, fabriqués avec des technologies de pointe. 550  salariés dans cinq usines en Alle-magne et en France contribuent à ce succès - Rejoignez-les !
Nous recherchons pour notre usine à 79258 Hartheim am Rhein / Allemagne : un conducteur de machine (H/F) pour la fabrication de pavés et de bordures - travail en 2 postes.

Vos principales missions sont :
- conduite, dépannage, maintenance et entretien de la machine
- surveillance du déroulement des processus
- transformation et réglage de la machine en cas de changement de produit
- respect des normes de qualité requises spécifiques à la qualité et aux paramètres du produit
- réalisation et documentation des contrôles de qualité

Votre profil :
- Un diplôme de formation technique, par ex. en mécanique industrielle, mécatronique ou électronique, technicien de procédés indus-triels (m/f) ou profil comparable.
Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle en tant que conducteur de machine.
- Bonne compréhension technique
- Polyvalence, fiabilité et capacité à travailler en équipe, sens des responsabilités et travail de manière autonome et structurée
- Permis chariot élévateur
- Bonnes connaissances en allemand exigées

Nous vous proposons :
Un emploi diversifié dans une entreprise familiale tournée vers l'avenir, un salaire basé sur la convention collective de l'Industrie Steine und Erden Baden-Württemberg (ISTE), des possibilités de formation continue sur mesure et une épargne retraite complémentaire.

* Familiarity with documentation management, version control, and review processes

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Csoportkoordinátor- Külső csomagolási projektek (Leiter/in - Logistik)
description:
Bevezetés

Részt venni a változás alakításában. Egy lépéssel megelőzni a holnap kihívásait már ma. Együtt növekedni egy fejlődő iparágban. Értékeink mentén, felelősen viselkedni. TÚLLÉPNI A HATÁROKAT. Ezt jelenti a DEUFOL csapatában dolgozni.
Világszerte 3 kontinensen, 12 ország 90 telephelyén, 2400 motivált munkatársunkkal, globális szereplők vagyunk az ellátási lánc megoldások és az ipari csomagolás területén.

Milyen feladatokra számíthatsz?

- Külső (a Deufol Hungary telephelyén kívül megvalósítandó) csomagolási és logisztikai projektek megvalósításának menedzsmentje az üzleti partnereink telephelyein (Debrecenen belül, illetve kívül, több változó helyszínen a régióban), a munkavállalók és a szakmai feladatok koordinálása
- A különféle külső helyszíneken az ipari termékek szakszerű, a megrendelésben meghatározott specifikációknak megfelelő csomagolásának, valamint a lecsomagolt termékek adminisztrációs, anyagmozgatási feladatainak biztosítása, a tevékenységek koordinálása
- Az ügyfélelégedettség biztosítása a külső csomagolási projektek során: egyeztetés a helyi kapcsolattartóval a helyszínen elvégzendő feladatokról, prioritásokról, reklamációs esetek kivizsgálása és részvétel a reakciós folyamatban.
- A külső csomagolási tevékenységekhez felhasznált csomagolóanyagok helyszínre történő kiszállítása céges autóval, szükség esetén fuvarszervezés
- A csapat tevékenységéhez kapcsolódó dokumentációs, riportolási és adminisztrációs feladatok ellátása a csoportvezető felé
- Együttműködés a cégen belüli társterületekkel, illetve a külső partnerekkel

Hozzád illik a pozíció, ha:

- Magabiztos, releváns tapasztalattal rendelkezel kisebb, néhány fős csapat vezetésében és koordinálásában gyártási, termelési, raktári, logisztikai területen
- Magabiztos számítógép-felhasználói ismeretekkel rendelkezel, gyakorlottan használod a MS Office alkalmazásokat; előny, ha valamilyen logisztikai, vállalatirányítási szoftver használatában van már tapasztalatod
- Legalább középfokú végzettséggel rendelkezel; előny a szakirányú végzettség vagy tapasztalat logisztika, ellátási lánc menedzsment, ipari csomagolási, faipari, raktári területen
- Vállalod a külső helyszíneken történő munkavégzést, a rendszeres kiküldetéseket Magyarországon belül, illetve szükség esetén (várhatóan nagyon ritka esetben) külföldre is - a munkavégzésed helyszíne részben a Deufol Hungary székhelye, részben a különböző partnereink telephelyei lesznek
- Rendelkezel B kategóriás jogosítvánnyal és vezetési tapasztalattal
- Előnyt jelent, ha rendelkezel érvényes targoncavezetői vagy híddaru kezelői jogosítvánnyal
- Terhelhető, rugalmas vagy
- Önálló, felelősségteljes munkavégzés jellemez
- Jó kommunikációs, szervező- és problémamegoldó készséggel rendelkezel
- Pozitív, csapatjátékos és ügyfélközpontú hozzáállásod van
- Alapfokú aktív angol nyelvtudás előny (mindennapi munkahelyi helyzetekben tudod használni, pl. e-mailezés, egyszerű telefonhívások/helyszíni egyeztetések)

Hogyan tudunk inspirálni?

- Stabil cég vagyunk, hosszú távon számíthatsz ránk és mi is hosszú távon gondolkodunk benned
- 180 fős munkavállalói létszámunk biztosítja a közvetlen, támogató közeget, ahol a vezetők is mindig elérhetők
- Innovatív, növekvő nemzetközi vállalati környezetben dolgozhatsz
- Érdekes és felelősségteljes feladatokat végezhetsz, csapatban közösen és a saját tudásod, kreativitásod és személyiséged használva
- Piacnak megfelelő juttatási csomagga

title: Technischer Vertriebsaußendienst (m/w/d) – Marktentwicklung Ungarn (Elektroniker/in - Automatisierungs- und Systemtechnik)
description:

- Viel Eigenverantwortung, kurze Entscheidungswege und ein familiäres Arbeitsumfeld

Sie…

- … gewinnen neue Kunden und bauen langfristige Geschäftsbeziehungen auf
- … betreuen und entwickeln Bestandskunden im gesamten Vertriebsgebiet
- … beraten Unternehmen zu unseren technischen Dienstleistungen und Lösungen
- … erkennen Marktpotenziale und erschließen neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten
- … repräsentieren unser Unternehmen bei Kunden, Messen und Veranstaltungen

Ihre Qualifikationen - ÜBERZEUGEND:

- Ungarisch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie gute Deutsch-, gerne auch Englischkenntnisse
- Erfahrung im technischen B2B-Vertrieb oder Außendienst
- Freude an der Neukundengewinnung und dem Ausbau langfristiger Kundenbeziehungen
- Technisches Verständnis für erklärungsbedürftige Produkte oder Dienstleistungen
- Selbstständige, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Ungarns

Darauf können Sie sich freuen - INFORMATIV:

- Intensive Einführungsphase in der Zentrale mit Abteilungsrotation & Tandembesuchen im Außendienst
- Spannende Projekte mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum und Eigenverantwortung
- Individuell abgestimmte Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Langfristige Perspektive in einem international erfolgreichen Familienunternehmen

Seit 1987 sind wir löwenstark am Markt – innovativ, familiär und zukunftsorientiert.

Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen mit Sitz in Hanau gehören wir zu den führenden Spezialisten für Reparatur, Verkauf und Service von CNC-, SPS- und Robotertechnik sowie Elektronik für erneuerbare Energien, Maritimer Elektronik sowie Elektronik in der Gebäudetechnik. Wir halten Maschinen am Laufen – weltweit.

Werden Sie Teil unseres #löwenstarkenteams und gestalten Sie den Ausbau unseres Vertriebs in Ungarn aktiv mit.

title: Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) (Arbeitsplanungsingenieur/in)
description:
Our Operations Team of OSI Food Solutions searches a Capacity Planning Specialist EU (m/f/d) in either Toledo, Spain/ Bábolna, Hungary or Ostróda, Poland.

What your job includes

- Coordinating and analyzing the overall EU volume flow for assigned areas, ensuring smooth planning and alignment across sites
- Managing end-to-end volume planning, including demand adjustments, allocation, promotional volumes, and volume transfers between EU plants
- Working with planning tools (Excel, SAP, SAP IBP), preparing scenarios, monitoring deviations and supporting continuous improvement
- Collaborating closely with local EU sites, sales, supply chain, finance, and logistics partners to maintain accurate and efficient planning processes
- Supporting stock management, analyzing demand trends, production and delivery performance and contributing to corrective actions
- Preparing reports on planning adherence, stock trends and demand evolution
- Participating in planning projects and supporting the annual budget allocation process
- Engaging in SAP / SAP IBP implementation, helping shape systems and processes

What we expect from you

- Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Data Analysis, or a similar field
- Experience in a complex supply chain manufacturing environment and in a coordination role involving planning, stock management or forecasting
- Analytical mindset with confidence in building and maintaining data analysis structures
- Autonomy in decision-making
- Strong communication and presentation skills
- Proactive approach to process improvements and openness to change
- Experience with SAP is a significant advantage
- Very good English (written and verbal); additional local language skills are beneficial

What we offer you

We are a company with flat hierarchies, value-based corporate culture and a pronounced customer orientation in a special market. We know that the commitment of our employees is the basis of our success. We therefore support you by quickly giving you responsibility and developing you according to your talents.

Other benefits depending on the location

title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

title: Assistant driller
description:
Seeking an assistant driller

Iceland Drilling Company (IDC) is an international leader in geothermal drilling, committed to providing safe and efficient drilling solutions with a focus on sustainability. We take pride in operating advanced, automatic drilling rigs that create a safe and positive working environment for our highly motivated crew members.

Key Responsibilities:
• Responsibility for correct mud tank settings, mixing mud and mud additives, measurement of specific gravity and viscosity of mud, monitior and cleaning mud pumps and pits.
• Trip in – lubricating threads and assisting with drill string assembly and removal of drill string.
• Receipt, measurement and cleaning of casings, assisting with casing assembly.
• Installation and arrangement of BOP‘s.
• Assisting with cementing.
• Reception and clearing up of drilling equipment (drill bits, stabilizers, jars, mud motors, MWD‘s etc).
• Substitute for driller/assistant driller as needed.

Qualifications & Requirements:
• Experience within geothermal drilling is preferred. Experience with Drillmec or Bentec rigs strongly preferred. Experince as Derrickman. 2 years minimum Assistant Driller experience highly preferred.
• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. Strong problem-solving and initiative, fluency in English. Good experince operating powertools.
• Valid driver's license. Icelandic forklift license (preferred). IWCF license, level 1-2 preferred. Forklift license for 10 tons + preferred.
• Proactive approach to hazard identification and control. Ability to work effectively in remote and demanding environments. Ability to work under pressure and in challenging environments.
• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to make quick decisions.
• Safety-conscious with a commitment to maintaining high safety standard.

Employer can assist with housing.

Full time job – shift work; work arrangements vary depending on the project.
Wages according to collective agreements with Framsýn workers union.

Please apply by sending your application and CV to: jons@jardboranir.is.
Last application date is October 31, 2026.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

title: Senior QA Analyst
description:
As a Senior Quality Assurance Analyst on an EVE Online gameplay team, you will guide testing from early design through release and live monitoring. You will work closely with design, engineering, and production to identify risks, shape test coverage, and help the team deliver reliable, engaging gameplay.

You will develop deep knowledge of your team's gameplay systems and how they interact with the wider game. As an advocate for players, you will contribute to design discussions, challenge assumptions, and provide actionable feedback on gameplay and usability. You will also coordinate outsourced testing while improving how the team builds quality into everyday development.

Your Tasks
Own the team's test approach, maintaining test plans, cases, regression coverage, and supporting documentation with input from the team.
Perform hands-on testing of gameplay features, mechanics, and interactions with existing systems, from design through release.
Assess quality risks, estimate testing effort, and partner with the producer to ensure adequate testing time and coverage. Coordinate testing across the development team and outsourced testers, providing clear priorities, instructions, and feedback.
Drive collaboration across teams and encourage shared ownership of quality.
Manage defects through triage, investigation, prioritization, and verification, helping the team make informed release decisions.
Review player bug reports, external issue lists, and relevant forum discussions to identify issues within the team's domain.
Coordinate deployment testing and post-release verification, communicating results and outstanding risks.
Ensure coverage across PC and Mac, including appropriate platform, performance, and regression testing.
Monitor relevant code, asset, and data changes, and coordinate access to working test environments, tools, and pipelines.
Improve testing practices and identify opportunities for automation, contributing to automated tests where appropriate.

Your Profile
At least five years of software or game testing experience, including coordinating and working effectively with outsourced testers.
A thorough understanding of development processes and testing throughout the project lifecycle.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate game mechanics, controls, interfaces, player feedback, rules, and rewards.
Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to reproduce, isolate, and clearly document defects.
The ability to prioritize testing based on risk and communicate quality concerns clearly.
Excellent written and spoken English, with strong collaboration skills.
An organized, methodical, and proactive approach, combined with curiosity and creative problem-solving.

Nice to Have:
Familiarity with Scripting, Python or other programming languages.
Experience with test automation.
Experience working in Agile development teams.
Knowledge of EVE Online or experience testing complex multiplayer gameplay systems.

What We Can Offer You
The challenge of working on ambitious projects with amazingly smart and creative co-workers.
A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.

An active fun division that hosts regular events.

title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

description:

This role is responsible for executing and troubleshooting cell based potency assay, ensuring compliance with regulatory and GMP standards, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the QC laboratory.



Key Responsibility:

Executing and troubleshooting cell based potency assays. Provide good technical input for Invalid assays investigations.

Executes non‑routine activities, including deviations, change controls, CAPAs, and related investigation actions.

Prepare testing protocols and reports, and review laboratory and cell bank documentation.

Qualifications and experience:

Master’s degree or Ph.D in Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Biology, or a related field.

SCOR Management Services Ireland is hiring a fixed term behavioural science analyst for our Windmill Lane, Dublin 2 office. The Behavioural Modelling team combines behavioural science, insurance expertise and data-driven methods to improve decisions and customer outcomes. The role requires a behavioural insurance specialist who can work independently with underwriting, client and technology stakeholders, turn evidence into practical recommendations, and lead defined workstreams from diagnosis through implementation and measurement. The successful candidate will apply behavioural insight to underwriting processes and disclosures, improve consumer digital journeys through research and experimentation, and support the responsible adoption of AI in business workflows. Required experience & competencies Experience: • Minimum two years’ professional experience in the insurance or reinsurance sector. • Practical understanding of insurance underwriting processes, consumer journeys and insurance business workflows. • Experience applying behavioural science, customer research, experimentation or data analysis to insurance problems. • Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders and delivering projects with clear business outcomes. • Exposure to AI-enabled tools, digital transformation or technology adoption initiatives is desirable. Required Education Masters or similiar in Behavioural Economics, Psychology or Behavioural Finance Remuneration Package Salary €34,755 Health insurance Min value €1,850 Bonus 0-12% Pension Employer contribution 8% and Employee contribution 4% Full time - 37.5 hours.

In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
You will be a healthcare assistant working across our Social Care division. Hours: Full time permanent 40 hours Salary ranges from €33,530 to €36,004 however this may be increased based on Qualifications & Experience What is the Role? You will provide a professional, high quality and safe service as a healthcare assistant to people with additional needs - working as part of a team and in consultation with each service user. You will make sure all of the client's needs are met in a completely individual way, and as an ambassador of Resilience's values, you will represent Best Quality - providing best-in-class care always. Individuality - applying a person-centered approach to meet each individual's abilities, needs and challenges Empowerment - helping all our service-users live their very best life and achieve their optimal potential. What Will Your Responsibilities Be? The delivery of client care needs and the development, implementation and evaluation of Support Plans; Ensure that practices within the service comply with Resilience's policies and procedures, to maintain the highest standards; Liaise with Multi-Disciplinary Teams ('MDTs') when required; Provide support to colleagues within the team setting; Act as a mentor for new staff and foster a positive learning environment; Participate in the development and review of risk assessments and report concerns. What is Required? You will have: FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent; Completed or be willing to complete a Patient Manual Handling course; Eligibility to work in Ireland; A strong sense of empathy, flexibility and a team-oriented work ethic. Previous experience working with adults/children with physical, sensory and intellectual disabilities would be an advantage A Full Drivers Licence is desirable. How Will You Benefit? This is your opportunity to: Develop and progress your career through full induction, training and ongoing development. Enjoy excellent rates of pay Resilience Rewards employee discounts e.g discounted health insurance Make your mark as part of a service that is changing the future of care in Ireland. Employee Assistance Programme 24/7 Resilience4Me Health and Well-being Forum Enjoy a personal, one-to-one approach to social care support work. Benefit from the full support of management. Earn from our paid Refer-a-Friend scheme. FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent

title: Care Assistant
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The Care Assistant plays a key role in supporting adults with intellectual disabilities to live meaningful, fulfilling lives within a warm and inclusive home environment. Working as part of the house team, the Care Assistant provides person-centred support, contributes to the daily life of the house, and fosters positive relationships with Core Members, colleagues, and volunteers. The role involves practical care, emotional support, participation in community life, and collaboration with the House/Team Leader and wider team to ensure high-quality support in line with L’Arche values. Reporting to: House leader / Team Leader / Deputy Team Leader In Relation to the Core Members Build respectful, trusting, and supportive relationships with each Core Member. Support Core Members in their daily living activities (personal care, meals, household tasks, etc.) while promoting independence. Encourage and support Core Members to make choices and take responsibility in their own lives. Uphold the dignity, self-esteem, and individuality of each person. Follow care plans and Person-Centred Plans (PCPs) in line with HIQA standards. Support Core Members in communication, ensuring their voice is heard and respected. Assist with social, recreational, and community activities in line with Core Members’ interests. Support Core Members to attend appointments (medical, social, etc.) as required. Assist in maintaining accurate and confidential records. Support safe medication practices as directed and trained. Promote a safe, clean, and healthy living environment. In Relation to the Staff Team Work collaboratively as part of the house team, supporting a positive and respectful team culture. Follow guidance from the House/Team Leader and contribute to the smooth running of the house. Participate in team meetings, training, and reflective practice. Communicate effectively with colleagues regarding Core Members’ needs and daily updates. Support new staff and volunteers through welcoming and sharing knowledge of daily routines. Contribute to a supportive and cooperative team environment. Attend support and supervision sessions In Relation to Volunteer Assistants Welcome and include Volunteer Assistants as part of the team. Support volunteers in understanding their role and the daily life of the house. Work alongside volunteers to ensure consistent and supportive care for Core Members. Promote a culture of inclusion, learning, and shared responsibility. In Relation to the House / Community Actively participate in the daily life and routines of the house. Support meal preparation, cleaning, and general household tasks. Contribute to creating a warm, welcoming, and inclusive home environment. Support celebrations, events, and community gatherings. Encourage Core Members’ participation in the wider community. Maintain awareness of health and safety procedures and follow all policies.

title: Logistics Controller
Financial Operations Specialist
description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
Location: Unit 9, Block D Nutgrove Office Park, Rathfarnham, Dublin, Leinster, Ireland D14 Y382 Roly type: Full-time, permanent – 37.5 hours per week Salary - €36,605 per annum The Financial Operations Specialist plays a key role in ensuring the accuracy, efficiency and continuous improvement of finance operations across billing, revenue management, cash collections and reporting. Working closely with stakeholders across the business, you'll help maintain financial integrity, improve processes and provide insights that support business performance. Key Responsibilities: Financial Analysis & Reporting Reconcile high-volume transactional data to ensure billing accuracy and revenue integrity. Produce regular financial and performance reports, including volume and margin analysis. Monitor billing activity, investigate discrepancies and implement corrective actions. Analyse financial data to identify trends, risks and opportunities. Support month-end and year-end reporting and reconciliation activities. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports and performance metrics. Process Improvement & Systems Identify opportunities to streamline processes, increase automation and improve efficiency. Support finance system enhancements and business improvement projects. Review existing workflows and implement solutions that improve accuracy and reduce manual effort. Act as a subject matter expert, helping the business maximise the value of finance systems and tools. Financial Controls & Compliance Maintain effective financial controls and ensure compliance with company policies. Monitor operational risks and implement control improvements where required. Maintain process documentation and support internal and external audits. Business Partnering Provide data-driven insights to support business planning and decision-making. Act as a key contact for invoicing and finance-related queries. Collaborate with stakeholders to improve processes, reporting and operational effectiveness. Financial Operations Support business-critical Direct Debit collections, managing substantial weekly cash flows. Oversee billing, revenue tracking, financial administration and reporting activities. Ensure timely invoicing and accurate revenue recognition. Maintain the accuracy and consistency of financial data across systems. Skills & Experience Experience in finance operations, financial analysis, billing or revenue management. Strong analytical skills and attention to detail. Advanced Excel skills and experience working with large datasets. Experience producing financial reports, reconciliations and performance analysis. Strong problem-solving and process improvement capabilities. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience with financial systems and reporting tools. This is an excellent opportunity for a finance professional who enjoys combining data analysis, operational ownership and continuous improvement to help drive business success.

description:

Installations Scheduler Part-time (20 hours/week) · Permanent · Glasnevin, Dublin 11 (DCU Alpha) At Transpoco, we help commercial vehicle fleets in Ireland, the UK and Europe operate efficiently and safely through our telematics SaaS platform, with live vehicle location data, reports and insights, and solutions for EV transition, carbon reduction and driver safety 🌱 We're the market-leading telematics platform in Ireland, with big ambitions to grow 🚀 We're looking for a highly organised, customer-focused Installations Scheduler to join our Dublin team. Hours are flexible, worked across the week to cover core business days. Why this role? Own the customer's first experience – installation is often the first time customers see Transpoco in action. You'll be their single point of contact from booking to completion. Be the hub of the operation – you'll own the engineers' diaries and turn install, swap and service requests into an efficient daily plan. What you'll do Plan and schedule field engineers for installations, swaps, removals and service calls across Ireland and the UK Be the customer's main contact for bookings: dates, vehicle lists, site access and special requirements Get every install completed on the date we promised Confirm stock and devices are ready before each visit Keep the scheduling system and HubSpot accurate and up to date Handle rescheduling, cancellations and same-day changes calmly Chase failed or incomplete visits and escalate recurring blockers Speak up early when a plan isn't realistic, then own it once agreed Report weekly on jobs booked, completed, cancelled and order-to-install lead time Work closely with Sales, Support and the warehouse What you'll bring 1+ years in scheduling, dispatch, logistics or customer-facing coordination (preferred) Clear, confident communication by phone and in writing Strong organisation and attention to detail Calm under pressure and quick to re-plan Comfortable with scheduling tools, spreadsheets and CRM systems Bonus points HubSpot or similar CRM experience Good knowledge of Irish and UK geography An interest in fleet or vehicle technology Why you'll love working here Full training on our platform, hardware and scheduling tools, in a small, friendly team €23,400 per year (pro-rata for 20 hours/week), a permanent contract and company pension On-site at DCU Alpha, Glasnevin – close to the Botanical Gardens and The Gravediggers 🍺

title: collaudatore di circuiti stampati/collaudatrice di circuiti stampati
description: Ti piace lavorare con precisione, seguendo l'installazione elettromeccanica di macchinari? Cerchi un'opportunità in cui mettere in pratica le tue competenze tecniche? Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Diploma tecnico o qualifica professionale in ambito elettrico; Comprovata competenza nel cablaggio e nella manutenzione elettrica; Manualità e precisione; Disponibilità a trasferte su territorio nazionale; Gradita esperienza pregressa in ruoli similari. Consulta tutti i nostri annunci su www.gigroup.it Gi Group S.p.A. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Principali Responsabilità - Disegno e Progettazione: Sviluppo e modifica di disegni tecnici 2D/3D e distinte base utilizzando software CAD. - Gestione Fornitori & Preventivazione: Richiesta, raccolta e analisi dei preventivi di spesa da fornitori esterni, valutando il miglior rapporto qualità/prezzo/tempi di consegna. - Gestione Commesse: Monitoraggio dello stato di avanzamento di piccole commesse, assicurando il rispetto delle scadenze e degli standard qualitativi. - Interfaccia Aziendale: Coordinamento con i reparti interni (Produzione, Acquisti, Logistica) per garantire il flusso corretto delle informazioni e dei materiali. Requisiti Richiesti - Diploma di Perito Meccanico/Tecnico o Laurea triennale tecnica - Esperienza di almeno due o tre anni in realtà produttive organizzate - Disegno Tecnico: ottima conoscenza delle regole del disegno industriale, tolleranze dimensionali e geometriche, rugosità e accoppiamenti - Conoscenza software di modellazione 3D ( SolidWorks, Inventor, Solid Edge) e CAD 2D (Autocad). Preferibile l'ulteriore capacità di impiego della modellazione BIM - Progettazione e Dimensionamento Meccanico di Base: conoscenza delle verifiche statiche necessarie per il dimensionamento di un componente meccanico - Conoscenza di base delle proprietà dei principali materiali metallici (acciai da costruzione, acciai speciali, alluminio) e dei trattamenti termici standard. - Capacità di analizzare un progetto e/o disegno in funzione di dinamiche di costo/preventivazione. Garantisce il corretto funzionamento della linea produttiva, riducendo al minimo i tempi di fermo macchina e assicurando la qualità del prodotto stampato. Di cosa si tratta? Quali sono i vantaggi di questo percorso? Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da esperti del settore; Opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo; Possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda al completamento del percorso formativo previa valutazione positiva del percorso; La ricerca è rivolta a Candidati/e di età compresa tra 18-24 anni, in possesso di Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore Superiore o del quarto anno di IeFP di tipo Tecnico. Si offre inserimento con contratto di Apprendistato di 1° Livello in somministrazione di circa 9 mesi, in partenza a novembre, finalizzato ad una stabilizzazione a lungo termine. description: Gi Group SpA, prima agenzia italiana per il lavoro, ricerca per FIEGE ECOMMERCE LOGISTICS, realtà operante nel settore logistico, presso il magazzino dedicato al mondo e-fashion: ADDETTO/ADDETTA ALLA LOGISTICA E.COMMERCE E.FASHION Cosa troverai in Fiege Ecommerce: - Un magazzino all'avanguardia, sicuro, climatizzato, ordinato e pulito; - Un'azienda innovativa e seria; - Un ambiente di lavoro dinamico e positivo; - Attenzione ai dipendenti: mensa aziendale, convenzioni dedicate e ampio parcheggio libero. description: La Divisione Permanent di Gi Group (Aut. Min. 26/11/04 Prot. n. 1101-SG), con un team di consulenti dedicati, si occupa della ricerca e selezione di risorse con esperienza, che hanno voglia di intraprendere nuovi percorsi professionali. description: The future of automation needs your hands. And your brain. Do you have a natural passion for mechanics, electronics, and technology? title: segretario/segretaria
description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. The successful candidate will actively contribute to building Group accounting processes and must possess comprehensive knowledge of IFRS principles. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Translation of foreign subsidiaries' financial statements and management of foreign exchange differences. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. Knowledge of USGAAP and experience with Oracle are a plus Offer Permanent employment Contract RAL between €50,000 and €60,000 1 day of remote working per week #LI-AM2

title: Fahrer (m/w/divers) für Showtruck gesucht (Berufskraftfahrer/in)
description:
.....gesucht wird ein "bewirtender" Berufskraftfahrer oder "kundenorientierter" Gastronom mit Lkw-Führerschein.....

Wir suchen einen zuverlässigen und erfahrenen Lkw-Fahrer mit Führerschein C/CE für unseren Showtruck, der sich um die sichere und effiziente Beförderung unserer Gastronomie-Einrichtung kümmert und nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs ist, insbesondere in Italien und Frankreich.

Als Lkw-Fahrer werden Sie für die Bedienung und Wartung des Fahrzeugs verantwortlich sein und sicherstellen, dass alle Aufgaben im Zusammenhang mit dem Auf- und Abbau der Gastronomie-Einrichtung reibungslos durchgeführt werden. Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören die Fahrt zu den Veranstaltungsorten, der Auf- und Abbau der Einrichtung, der Ausschank und die Betreuung der Gäste. Wir suchen einen Kandidaten mit ausgeprägten Fahrkenntnissen, excellenten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und einer tiefen Erfahrung im Umgang mit Lkw und Gastronomie-Einrichtungen.

Die Stelle erfordert eine hohe Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, nahezu ganzjährig unterwegs zu sein. Wenn Sie eine Herausforderung suchen und sich für eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit begeistern, dann sind Sie bei uns richtig.

Zum Aufgabengebiet gehören voraussichtlich aber nicht ausschließlich:

- Mitreisetätigkeit an 6-10 Monaten am Stück im Jahr, ausdehnbar auf 12 Monate im Jahr, wenn erste Teilsaison stimmt
- Erfahrung im Betrieb/Mitreisen bei Schaustellerbetrieben, Eventbereich
- leichter Auf- und Abbau von Gerätschaften während der Tour
- Eventunterstützung von Organisation vor Ort
- Terminplanung Tour
- Ausschankbetrieb
- Führerschein Klasse CE

Persönliche Voraussetzungen:

- Unabhängigkeit
- Altersvorgabe 30-58
- technisches Verständnis Light&Sound und LKW-Technik
- englisch fließend, jede weitere Fremdsprache ist willkommen
- Persönlichkeit: präsent, kommunikativ, selbstbewusst

Interesse? Bitte teilen Sie uns mit, wenn Sie weitere Fragen haben oder wenn Sie sich für diese Stelle interessieren.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Gästebetreuung, Fahrzeugführung, Getränke zubereiten und anrichten, Technisches Verständnis

description: L'innovazione e le nuove tecnologie ti affascinano e appassionano? Ti piacerebbe far parte del processo innovativo contribuendo alla realizzazione di tecnologie all'avanguardia? Ecco l'opportunità che stavi cercando! L'Academy che ti proponiamo è realizzata in partnership con CRIF Spa, gruppo internazionale specializzato in soluzioni digitali, sistemi decisionali, software e servizi per il settore finanziario, presente in oltre 35 Paesi e attivo nello sviluppo di tecnologie innovative a livello globale. NEOLAUREATI/E in STATISTICA - ACADEMY JUNIOR DATA SCIENTIST Cerchiamo giovani talenti da formare e inserire come Junior Data Scientist attraverso un percorso di Academy altamente qualificante e totalmente gratuito. Cosa prevede l'Academy: - 4 Settimane di corso virtuale, con data start Lunedì 12 Ottobre 2026; - Lezioni frontali e project work con il supporto di docenti qualificati; - Possibilità di inserimento al termine del percorso tramite contratto a tempo determinato in somministrazione Gi Group; - L'Academy si svolgerà interamente in modalità virtuale; - Corso completamente gratuito per tutti i partecipanti. Che cosa imparerai? Sarai formato/a per ricoprire il ruolo di Junior Data Scientist, sviluppando competenze nell'analisi di grandi volumi di dati e trasformarli in insight utili al business. Lavorerai con Python (anche in ottica OOP) e con strumenti come Pandas e NumPy per preparare, pulire e valorizzare i dataset, fino a realizzare analisi e visualizzazioni efficaci e dashboard. Entrerai poi nel cuore della disciplina costruendo modelli predittivi e di scoring (classificazione e regressione), approfondendo le principali tecniche di feature engineering, clustering, serie storiche e ottimizzazione dei modelli, per coprire l'intero ciclo di vita di un progetto analitico. Completerai il percorso con un'introduzione alla Generative AI, ai LLM e al Prompt Engineering, per comprendere come integrare questi strumenti in soluzioni data-driven anche in contesti progettuali internazionali. Cosa cerchiamo? - Laureandi/Neolaureati/e in Statistica - Conoscenza di base di Python, SQL, R; - Doti analitiche, problem solving, capacità comunicative e motivazione a lavorare in ambito consulenziale - Buona conoscenza della lingua INGLESE. Sede corso: Modalità virtuale; Orario corso: Full-Time da lunedì al venerdì dalle 9:00 alle 18:00. description: Vuoi essere parte del cambiamento digitale e della trasformazione tecnologica? Hai esperienza in ambito ICT e vuoi lavorare su progetti innovativi? Il ruolo ha una forte componente tecnico-operativa e prevede la responsabilità diretta sull'esecuzione dei controlli di sicurezza, sul monitoraggio degli eventi e sul supporto alle attività di incident management, in ambienti sia on-premise sia cloud. Cosa farai: - Implementare, configurare e gestire operativamente soluzioni di sicurezza enterprise (EDR/XDR, SIEM, firewall, IDS/IPS, IAM) - Monitorare gli eventi di sicurezza e analizzare i log per individuare anomalie e potenziali minacce - Supportare le attività di incident response, investigazione tecnica e contenimento degli incidenti - Gestire endpoint, server e infrastrutture dal punto di vista della sicurezza - Collaborare con il SOC e con fornitori esterni per l'analisi e la risoluzione degli alert - Supportare le attività di vulnerability assessment e la remediation delle vulnerabilità - Contribuire all'implementazione delle misure di sicurezza definite dall'architettura (security by design) - Fornire supporto operativo su temi di backup, disaster recovery e continuità operativa Competenze tecniche richieste: - Esperienza pratica con soluzioni EDR/XDR, SIEM e sistemi di logging centralizzato - Conoscenza dei principali meccanismi di sicurezza di rete (firewall, VPN, IDS/IPS) - Capacità di analisi di log ed eventi di sicurezza - Conoscenza dello stack TCP/IP e dei principali protocolli di rete - Comprensione dei principi di crittografia, gestione dei certificati e protocolli sicuri (TLS, SSH) - Esperienza o familiarità con soluzioni di Identity & Access Management - Familiarità con ambienti cloud Orario di lavoro: 8 ore al giorno, dal lunedì al venerdì con flessibilità in entrata dalle 8:30 alle 10:00 e pausa pranzo obbligatoria di 1 ora( tra 12:30 e 15:00). Sono inoltre previsti ticket restaurant del valore di 5 euro per ogni giorno lavorato in sede, scontistica in store, Fondo Est, smartworking 2 giorni a settimana. description: Project Manager - Cantieri navali Nuove Costruzioni L'Azienda Il nostro cliente è uno storico cantiere navale genovese con un consolidato know how nella riparazione e costruzione navale. Il ruolo Nell'ambito dello sviluppo del business delle nuove costruzioni, siamo alla ricerca di un Project Manager che segua la realizzazione delle commesse dalla fase di avvio fino alla consegna finale, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi contrattuali, tecnici, economici, temporali e qualitativi. Opererà come principale punto di riferimento verso Direzione, Cliente e funzioni interne, coordinando in modo strategico e gestionale tutte le attività necessarie alla corretta esecuzione del progetto. Principali responsabilità Gestire l'intero ciclo di vita della commessa di nuova costruzione, dall'avvio alla consegna finale dell'unità. Pianificare e monitorare il programma generale di commessa, assicurando milestone e scadenze contrattuali. Coordinare funzioni interne e stakeholder (Ufficio Tecnico, Produzione, Procurement, Qualità, HSE, AFC/Controllo di Gestione). Gestire la parte economica della commessa: predisposizione e monitoraggio di budget/forecast, controllo costi, cash flow, analisi scostamenti e azioni correttive a tutela della marginalità. Selezionare e gestire fornitori/subappaltatori/partner: valutazione offerte, controllo prestazioni e gestione criticità/ritardi. Gestire la relazione con Cliente/Armatore/Classifica/Autorità: governance, riunioni di avanzamento, comunicazioni e reporting. Governare aspetti contrattuali e tecnici (varianti, change order, extra work, claim) e assicurare commissioning/HAT/prove in mare, chiusura punch list, non conformità e documentazione finale. Il Profilo Ideale Formazione: Laurea in Ingegneria Navale (valutabili Ingegneria Meccanica/Industriale o titoli equivalenti con consolidata esperienza nel settore). Esperienza: - Consolidata esperienza (almeno 8-10 anni) nel ruolo di Project Manager nel settore navale con un focus sulla costruzione navale o in società del settore marittimo. - Preferibile esperienza presso primari cantieri navali internazionali. - Esperienza su commesse di elevato valore economico e complessità tecnica. Competenze tecniche/gestionali: - Conoscenza dei processi e delle fasi di costruzione navale. - Buona conoscenza di strutture navali, impianti di bordo e discipline tecniche. - Capacità di lettura e interpretazione di specifiche tecniche, contratti, disegni costruttivi e documentazione di commessa. Lingue - Ottimo inglese scritto e parlato (seconda lingua preferenziale). Competenze personali - Leadership su team multidisciplinari e forte orientamento al risultato. - Decision making in contesti complessi, pianificazione e gestione priorità. - Flessibilità e disponibilità a trasferte. Cosa offriamo - Inserimento in un contesto industriale dinamico, in sviluppo nel business Nuove Costruzioni Navali. - Ruolo con responsabilità diretta su commesse complesse e strategiche. - CCNL applicabile: CCNL metalmeccanico-industria - Livello di inquadramento: B3/Q - Fascia di RAL da attribuire alla posizione: 60.000€ - 75.000€ - Benefit: mensa, polizza sanitaria e welfare da CCNL. title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. perkame juodųjų ir spalvotųjų metalų laužą Lietuvoje, parduodame perdirbėjams ir eksportui per Klaipėdą. Ieškome vadybininko, kuris veda sandorį nuo tiekėjo iki pirkėjo ir atsako už jo maržą.
Uždarbis – bazinė dalis ir komisiniai nuo sandorio maržos.

Pirkimo pusė.

Tiekėjų paieška: metalo apdirbimo ir gamybos įmonės, statybos ir demontavimo objektai, laivų
remontas, transporto aikštelės, savivaldybių įmonės.
Objektų apžiūra vietoje: kiek medžiagos, kokios rūšies ir būklės, ar ją reikės pjaustyti, kaip bus
kraunama.
Kainos pasiūlymas pagal medžiagos rūšį ir tos dienos kainoraštį.
Susitarimas dėl konteinerio ar mašinos pastatymo, pakrovimo laiko ir svėrimo vietos.
Atskaitymų už priemaišas derinimas su tiekėju iki pakrovimo.
Pardavimo pusė
Pirkėjų paieška ir derybos Lietuvoje, Baltijos šalyse ir eksporto rinkose.
Partijos komplektavimas iš kelių tiekėjų iki vieno kokybės lygio.
Kainos derinimas pagal tarptautinius indeksus.
Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.
Sandorio vedimas
Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.
Regionas
Pasiteisinus pirmiems rezultatams – naujo regiono atidarymas ir jo tiekėjų tinklo formavimas.

title: Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director (m/f)
description:
Digital Factory - Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director
Location:  Luxembourg
Other locations:  Anywhere in Region
Salary: Competitive

Job description
Requisition ID:  1729702

Digital Solution Lead (Assurance) - Associate Director

At EY, we're all in to shape your future with confidence.

We'll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Role Overview:

The Associate Director - Digital Solution Lead is accountable for leading a defined portfolio of digital projects for EY Luxembourg's Assurance Service Line. Acting as a program manager equivalent, the role translates Assurance priorities into an executable digital roadmap, governs demand and delivery across multiple squads, and ensures solutions are adopted, controlled, and delivering measurable value. The Digital Solution Lead partners with Assurance leadership, project teams, Digital Architects Team, to deliver high-impact digital capabilities with strong governance, financial discipline, and client-service focus.

Responsibilities:

• Own and manage a defined portfolio of Assurance digital projects from intake and prioritization through delivery, adoption, and benefits realization.
• Translate Assurance Service Line priorities into a practical digital roadmap, aligning portfolio choices with business value, regulatory expectations, user needs, and Digital Factory strategy.
• Lead demand intake, triage, business case shaping, and prioritization with Assurance Partners, Directors, Senior Managers, product owners, and operational stakeholders.
• Establish and run portfolio governance, including steering committee materials, decision logs, RAID management, dependency tracking, and clear escalation routes.
• Manage delivery plans, milestones, scope trade-offs, risks, issues, and interdependencies across multiple concurrent initiatives, intervening directly when delivery confidence is at risk.
• Coordinate multidisciplinary teams across Assurance subject matter experts, business analysts, developers, data engineers, UI/UX, QA, change management, and enabling functions.
• Oversee portfolio budget, capacity planning, resource allocation, and financial tracking, ensuring transparency between planned investment, actual spend, and expected value.
• Ensure digital solutions meet business requirements and EY quality expectations, including data protection, cybersecurity, independence, auditability, risk management, and compliance considerations.
• Drive adoption with Assurance users through stakeholder engagement, communication, training readiness, feedback loops, release planning, and post-implementation support.
• Provide concise, executive-ready reporting to Assurance leadership and Digital Factory governance on progress, value, risks, decisions required, and portfolio health.
• Coach project managers, and delivery teams, building delivery discipline and a culture of accountability across the portfolio.
• Promote reuse, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement across Assurance digital assets, delivery practices, and operating model ways of working.

Expectations:

• Act as a trusted advisor to Assurance leadership, able to challenge priorities constructively and recommend pragmatic portfolio decisions.
• Operate with senior judgment, balancing strategic portfolio ownership with hands-on delivery support when projects require intervention.
• Influence effectively in a matrix environment, aligning senior stakeholders who may have different commercial, operational, technical, and risk perspectives.
• Represent the Digital Factory in Assurance forums with credibility, clarity, and a strong understanding of how digital delivery improves audit quality, efficiency, and user experience.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Engineering, Project Management, Finance, Audit, or a related field.
• Experience in digital transformation or software/product delivery or program management, ,
• Proven track record leading teams, engagements, budgets, dependencies, risks, and measurable business outcomes.
• Experience in Assurance, audit, professional services, financial services, or another regulated environment is strongly preferred; willingness to build Assurance domain depth quickly is essential.
• Command of Project Management and Agile delivery methods, with the ability to apply governance pragmatically rather than mechanically.
• Working knowledge of digital solution delivery, including data and analytics, workflow automation, AI-enabled capabilities, integration considerations, testing, release management, and support transition.
• Strong financial management, capacity planning, benefits tracking, and executive reporting capabilities.
• Excellent communication, stakeholder management, influencing, and facilitation skills, with the ability to translate between business, operational, and technical audiences.
• People leadership experience, including coaching delivery contributors and building high-performing teams in a matrix organization.
• Fluent English is required.

Preferred Experience and Certifications:

• Recognized project, program, product, or agile certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, MSP, SAFe, Scrum Master, or Product Owner are an asset.
• Experience with delivery and collaboration platforms such as Azure DevOps, Microsoft 365, Power Platform, or equivalent enterprise tooling.
• Exposure to audit technology, data governance, automation, AI adoption, or digital operating model transformation in a professional services environment.

What we offer you

At EY, we'll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We'll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
EY  |  Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.
