title: Material Technology Engineer – Comfort
description:
Company Description

Help create the next generation of comfort solutions

Are you passionate about textiles, comfort, and material innovation? Do you want to influence how millions of people experience comfort in their everyday life?

We're looking for a Material Technology Engineer - Comfort to drive the development of innovative materials, technologies, and manufacturing solutions within our Textile & Comfort area. You will combine deep material expertise with a strong understanding of customer needs, sustainability, and industrial production to create better products at an affordable price. Based on the responsibilities and competence requirements described for the Material Technology Engineer role.

Job Description

Your mission

As part of the Material & Engineering team, you will lead innovation and development projects focused on textiles, soft materials, comfort constructions, and related manufacturing technologies.

You will work closely with product developers, suppliers, innovation teams, and external partners to identify opportunities and transform ideas into scalable solutions.

Your responsibilities will include:

    Leading material and technology development projects within textile and comfort categories.
    Exploring new textile materials, fibers, constructions, fillings, foams, nonwovens, and comfort solutions.
    Evaluating emerging technologies and their potential application in future products.
    Supporting material roadmaps and identifying innovation opportunities that contribute to quality, sustainability, affordability, and customer value.
    Working early in the product development process to ensure optimal material and comfort solutions.
    Collaborating with suppliers, universities, startups, and industry experts to bring external innovation into the business.
    Developing and maintaining material specifications, quality requirements, and technical documentation.
    Driving knowledge sharing and capability building within Textile & Comfort.
    Supporting the implementation of new materials and technologies in industrial production.

Qualifications

Who you are

You are curious by nature and genuinely excited about understanding how materials influence comfort, functionality, durability, and sustainability.

We believe you have:

    A degree in Textile Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Product Development, or a related field.
    Experience working with textiles, soft materials, comfort products, upholstery, mattresses, bedding, furniture, automotive interiors, or related industries.
    Strong knowledge of textile materials, fiber technologies, fabric constructions, nonwovens, foams, fillings, or comfort systems.
    Experience leading development projects and working cross-functionally in complex environments.
    The ability to translate customer needs into material and technology solutions.
    A strong interest in sustainability, circularity, recycled materials, and future material innovations.
    Excellent stakeholder management and collaboration skills.
    Strong communication skills in English.

We think you'll thrive if you are

    Passionate about textiles and comfort.
    Curious about future materials and emerging technologies.
    Able to combine technical depth with commercial understanding.
    Analytical and comfortable working with both data and hands-on testing.
    Energised by collaboration across functions, cultures, and external networks.
    Motivated by creating products that improve everyday life for the many people.

Additional Information

Why this role?

This is an opportunity to shape the future of comfort. You will work with material innovation from idea to implementation, influencing everything from next-generation textile materials to sustainable comfort solutions that reach customers around the world.

If you are excited about combining material science, textile expertise, innovation, and customer insight, we would love to hear from you.

Please see we will have this position open on several locations ( Älmhult, Warsaw, Shanghai and Ho Chi Minh City), it is however same position that we are looking for to be placed in one of these locations.

Apply now and help us create better comfort through better materials. Please send us your application – CV and letter of motivation – in English latest by 13 October 2026.

We wish for you to answer the following question:

    How do you see you could contribute as an MTE to the Textile and Comfort material innovation?

If you have questions about the role, please contact Material & Engineering Manager Catarina Englund at catarina.englund1@inter.ikea.com

If you have questions about the recruitment process, please contact People & Culture Specialist Femina Karlsson at femina.ladhani.karlsson@inter.ikea.com.

We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. We will first consider co-workers employed at Inter IKEA Group impacted by organizational changes provided competence requirements are met for the role.  

Welcome with your application!

title: ICEHOTEL - Chef
description:
A hotel built from snow and ice sourced from the Torne River, featuring art created by selected artists who travel here from across the globe. Our operations include traditional hotel rooms and cabins, Icehotel 365 – a hotel by night and an art gallery by day and, from mid-December to mid-April, our seasonal winter hotel made entirely of snow and ice.

We are passionate about creating enriching experiences and living in harmony with nature. In addition to the ice art, we offer nature-based activities and culinary experiences, both in-house and in collaboration with carefully selected partners, as a complement to the art.

About the Role

Join to our Breakfast and Lunch team, and create a memorable Swedish Arctic Breakfast experience to our guests through a buffet or a la carte service.

As a chef at ICEHOTEL, you’ll be part of a creative and dynamic team that delivers high-quality food experiences in a truly unique environment. We operate three distinct restaurants:

    The Restaurant – our main venue, open year-round, serving breakfast, lunch buffets, à la carte dinners, group menus, and special dietary requests. It’s also the hub for preparing over 3,000 meals for our tours and activities.

    The Old Homestead – our cozy winter bistro located in a 400-year-old wooden house by the Torne River, known for its signature pizzas and charcoal-grilled dishes.

    The Veranda – our chef’s table and show-cooking experience, where storytelling and creativity take center stage. Currently open during the winter season only.

Each restaurant has its own character, all rooted in the identity of Swedish Lapland.

Responsibilities

    Preparing and cooking our Breakfast, buffet or a la carte in a high quality, in line with ICEHOTEL’s culinary concept.

    Collaborate with the kitchen team to ensure smooth daily operations.

    Maintain high standards of hygiene, safety, and food quality.

    Contribute to menu development and seasonal offerings.

    Support events such as weddings, conferences, and private dining experiences.

Who are you?

We’re looking for a team player with a passion for food and a willingness to grow. You thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy working with others to create memorable guest experiences.

Qualifications

    Previous experience in a professional kitchen is an advantage, but not a requirement – we value attitude and willingness to learn.

    Ability to work under pressure and adapt to seasonal changes.

    Good communication skills in English.

    A genuine interest in food, sustainability, and nature-based experiences.

About the position

    Type of employment: Full-time, part-time, or seasonal.

    Start date: As agreed.

    Location: Jukkasjärvi, Sweden.

    Staff accommodation is available if needed.

What we offer

    A unique workplace in one of the world’s most extraordinary environments.

    The opportunity to take part in activities such as snowmobile safaris under the northern lights or ski tours with Swedish fika.

    A supportive and inclusive team culture.

    Staff benefits and discounts.

    Accommodation options for employees.

Applications are only accepted through this application method. The position may be filled before the final application date, so don’t wait to apply. If you have any questions, feel free to contact diego@icehotel.com.

To be eligible for the position, you must be an EU citizen or have a valid work permit in Sweden.

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Visual Merchandising & Commercial Lead - Sales Market Sweden
employer: H & M Hennes & Mauritz Sverige AB
description:
​​WHAT YOU’LL DO

As the Visual Merchandiser (VM) & Commercial Lead, you are the technical specialist ensuring that all commercial actions are optimized within the overall Brand direction and Sales market VM priorities, always securing an elevated, competitive and convenient customer experience within physical stores

You will:

    Act as operational interface to all other commercial functions in Sales Market, aligning VM execution based on Commercial Plan and activities through regular operational syncs while keeping the Head of Visual regularly informed.  
    Bring and communicate the VM technical perspective in weekly commercial planning meeting:  
    contributing to commercial decision-making and ensuring VM priorities are aligned and integrated into overall market plans and within the VM global direction.
    providing and sharing solutions concerning workload, resources and planning to support execution and drive salesmanship in stores.  
    Support and communicate with Sales Market, Area and Store teams on weekly commercial priorities, upcoming activity, commercial packages and seasonal focuses and in-store communication material.  
    Communicate any store activation plan updates in close collaboration with other commercial functions for Areas and Store teams for them to adapt if needed.  
    Steer and educate VM teams to be solution-oriented about how to optimize the visual and product presentation information based on actual stock availability and store conditions staying within the Brand direction.  
    Collaborate with Material leads and other functions for in–store material in line with Commercial plan.
    Secure close collaboration with Sales Market VM teams and store visit with Head Office VM to follow-up on VM standards level implementation in store and identify potential and provide support (e.g., presentation strategies, implementation of guidelines, activation plans, product presentation priorities).  
    In line with Sales Market VM Agenda and priorities, provide teams with routines, best practice and upskilling to secure visual and commercial excellence outcome in Sales Market.  
    In line with Sales Market VM Agenda and priorities, they share latest visual standards, seasonal and product presentation principles, customer groups updates and overall display and material with Sales Market, Areas & store teams.  
    Proactively seek, give, and receive feedback from Sales Markets and Global VM teams to continuously improve visual routines, standards, and commercial alignment.



WHO YOU ARE​

You are a skilled VM professional with strong visual, commercial, and analytical capabilities supported by solid fashion industry training. You bring senior VM leadership experience, proven commercial impact, and a collaborative way of working that drives consistent results.

    3+ years leadership experience in senior Visual Merchandising roles  
    Good knowledge about physical store identity, updated on latest visual strategies and commercial goals linked to assortment and customer groups.  
    Proved track record in driving commercial impact and developing visual teams  
    Cross- collaboration effectively to achieve results  
    Strong prioritization, planning, and preparation skills (Expert)  
    Visual Merchandising knowledge and Commercial competence (Expert)  
    commercial know-how, visual routines, workload and planning understanding, and customer experience knowledge  
    Solid analytical ability (e.g., know how to act on selling equation, weekly sales report and correlation between commercial KPIs & product presentation method based on different commercial activities etc.)



WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​



WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET, Afound. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP. You can read more about our H&M Incentive Program here.



JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, apply by sending your application in ENGLISH through the career site as soon as possible but no later than October 12th, 2026. As we review applications continuously, the role may be closed early.    

This is a permanent position based in Stockholm and the role reports to Visual Merchandising Manager.

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.​

title: Manager Mechanical Project Lead Engineering
description:
About the Role

As Manager for our Mechanical Project Lead Engineers within Engineering Mods & Ups, you will lead a team that turns complex technical challenges into reliable, customer-focused solutions. Your team will lead the engineering execution of mechanical modification projects for the complete Finspang gas turbine service fleet: SGT-500, SGT-600, SGT-700, SGT-750 and SGT-800.

Our projects are never standard. Each turbine has its own history, configuration and operating conditions. Your team’s mission is to lead and coordinate mechanical modifications throughout the project, from technical scope and planning to execution and delivery. The role requires strong leadership, sound engineering judgement and the ability to connect technical details with the overall project and customer need.

You will work closely with sales, project management, mechanical engineering disciplines and other key functions across Service. As the manager, you will create the conditions for clear ownership, effective cross-functional collaboration and predictable project execution. If you want to combine people leadership with technology and business impact, this is your opportunity.

Key Responsibilities

Lead & Inspire

    Develop and empower a team of Project Lead Engineers responsible for mechanical modification projects across the gas turbine service fleet
    Foster a culture of collaboration, technical curiosity, accountability and continuous improvement

Drive Excellence

    Own and develop the engineering execution for mechanical Mods & Ups projects, with focus on clear scope, planning, coordination and delivery
    Ensure technical and financial follow-up, manage interfaces and risks, and turn lessons learned into actionable improvements
    Act as first point of contact for new mechanical modification projects and coordinate priorities and workload with other engineering managers

Customer & Business Focus

    Collaborate with sales and project management to align technical scope, delivery plans and customer expectations
    Support complex technical discussions and guide your team in resolving cross-functional challenges throughout project execution

Qualifications

    Proven leadership experience as a manager, team lead or project leader in a technical environment
    Strong technical background in mechanical engineering, gas turbine engineering or a related discipline
    Experience of leading engineering projects and coordinating multiple technical interfaces
    Excellent communication skills, sound business judgement and the ability to build trust across teams and with customers

What We Bring to You

Your experience will be valued and amplified. As a manager in our team, you will join a leadership environment built on trust, collaboration and growth. You will have the mandate to develop both your team and how we execute mechanical modification projects across the Finspang gas turbine service fleet. Together with experienced colleagues and key partners across the business, you will help improve delivery performance, engineering quality and customer value.

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

We can offer you employment benefits such as: reduction of working hours, advance vacation, health care allowance and an eventual possibility to a flexible working place.

Who is Siemens Energy?

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Application

title: HV OR
description:
Role Overview

RLB is seeking an experienced Senior Electrical Authorised Person to support the safe delivery, commissioning, energisation and operational readiness of complex electrical infrastructure on a major data centre project.

The successful candidate will be responsible for managing HV and LV electrical safety activities, including isolations, switching, Permit to Work processes and Lockout/Tagout controls. The role will ensure that electrical works are planned and executed in accordance with project Electrical Safety Rules, approved procedures and relevant regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Electrical safety and control

    Act as an appointed Senior Electrical Authorised Person for relevant HV and LV electrical systems.
    Manage electrical isolations, de-isolations, switching and energisation activities in accordance with approved Electrical Safety Rules.
    Prepare, review and approve isolation plans, switching schedules and electrical safety documentation.
    Issue, manage, suspend and close electrical safety documents, including HV Permits to Work, LV Permits to Work, Sanctions for Test and Limitations of Access.
    Implement and maintain effective Lockout/Tagout processes for electrical and hazardous energy systems.
    Confirm that safe working conditions have been established before authorising work or testing activities.
    Stop, suspend or reject work where electrical safety requirements, documentation or site conditions are inadequate.
    Maintain accurate records of electrical isolations, permits, switching activities and safety-document status.

Construction and commissioning

    Support the safe installation, testing, commissioning and first energisation of HV and LV systems.
    Coordinate electrical activities across construction, commissioning, operations, client, vendor and contractor teams.
    Review commissioning plans, energisation procedures, test documentation and operational-readiness requirements.
    Chair or contribute to electrical construction and commissioning coordination meetings.
    Monitor ongoing installation and commissioning works to make sure they remain aligned with approved programmes, procedures and switching schedules.
    Support the controlled handover of electrical systems from construction through commissioning and into operations.
    Provide technical support during fault finding, testing and the resolution of electrical-system issues.

Documentation and technical assurance

    Review and approve electrical RAMS, work permits, insulation certificates, drawings, inspection and test plans and associated safety documentation.
    Ensure electrical works are completed in accordance with approved designs, technical specifications, relevant standards and project procedures.
    Review electrical installation quality and identify deficiencies, non-compliance or incomplete works.
    Work with design teams and site personnel to resolve design-related installation issues.
    Support technical reviews of proposed changes, deviations and electrical-system modifications.

Safety leadership and compliance

    Promote a strong electrical-safety culture across the project.
    Conduct electrical-safety inspections, audits and site walkdowns.
    Monitor compliance with hazardous-energy control, Permit to Work and Lockout/Tagout requirements.
    Identify electrical risks and ensure appropriate controls are implemented before activities proceed.
    Support EHS teams with safety meetings, toolbox talks, audits and incident-prevention activities.
    Investigate electrical-safety observations, incidents and near misses, supporting root-cause analysis and corrective actions.
    Escalate material risks, unsafe conditions and non-compliance promptly to the relevant project management.

Training and stakeholder coordination

    Provide guidance, coaching and technical support on Electrical Safety Rules and site procedures.
    Deliver or support Authorised Person, Competent Person, Permit to Work and Lockout/Tagout training.
    Assess the competence and understanding of personnel undertaking electrical activities.
    Build effective working relationships with client representatives, contractors, vendors, construction teams and commissioning teams.
    Provide concise reports on electrical-safety performance, audit findings, emerging risks and the status of corrective actions.

Candidate Profile

Qualifications and knowledge

    Degree, diploma or recognised technical qualification in Electrical Engineering, electrical power systems or a related discipline.
    Formal training and appointment experience as an Electrical Authorised Person or Senior Authorised Person.
    Strong knowledge of HV and LV electrical distribution systems.
    Thorough understanding of Electrical Safety Rules, Permit to Work and hazardous-energy control.
    Knowledge of switching, energisation, testing, commissioning and operational-handover activities.
    Understanding of electrical drawings, single-line diagrams, switching schedules and isolation plans.
    Knowledge of applicable electrical standards, construction safety requirements and industry good practice.
    Health and safety qualifications such as IOSH, NEBOSH or an equivalent would be advantageous.

Experience

    Significant experience working with HV and LV electrical systems in complex construction, commissioning or operational environments.
    Experience supporting large-scale data centres, industrial facilities, power generation, nuclear facilities or other mission-critical projects.
    Demonstrable experience managing electrical isolations, switching programmes and Permit to Work processes.
    Experience reviewing and approving RAMS, insulation certificates, electrical drawings and commissioning documentation.
    Experience supporting the first energisation and commissioning of critical electrical infrastructure.
    Experience conducting electrical-safety inspections and compliance audits.
    Experience coordinating contractors, vendors, commissioning teams and client stakeholders.
    Experience delivering electrical-safety or Competent Person training.
    Experience with simultaneous operations and the coordination of overlapping construction and commissioning activities.

Our Diversity, Equity & Inclusion Promise

We believe in building a diverse and inclusive environment where each person can be themselves, feel valued for their contribution, and be challenged and supported to reach their full potential.

If you require any reasonable adjustments during any stage of the application or interview process, please contact our recruitment team at recruitment@uk.rlb.com.

title: Raw Material Manager
description:
ABOUT THE COMPANY Tiger of Sweden is a Stockholm-based fashion house established in 1903 with a heritage in tailoring. For more than a century, Tiger of Sweden has stood for style with purpose, dressing men and women for whom true style is about the confidence to be themselves.

POSITION OVERVIEW As Raw Material Development Manager, you will be responsible for the development of all Tiger of Sweden fabrics and trims. Your work will be in line with our creative vision, commercial needs, business KPIs and sustainability targets, and you will maintain and revitalise our existing continuity lines. You bring in-depth knowledge of fabric construction, finishes and costing across all product groups, as well as a strong understanding of the global supply chain. Reporting to the [Head of Product Development], you will work closely with raw material suppliers and the Design and Product teams to execute creative and commercial briefs. You will also troubleshoot throughout the development process to ensure every product is fit for its end use.

TASKS & RESPONSIBILITIES

Fabric Development:

    

Design and develop raw materials that are fit for purpose, the customer and the brand, and that meet gross margin targets.

    

Be the business lead for R&D of new fabrics, technologies, concepts and future ideas.

    

Support, educate and inspire colleagues on fabric choice and new innovations.

    

Arrange and lead trips to mills and trade fairs.

    

Negotiate lead times and minimums with fabric suppliers from development through to bulk.

Technical Excellence:

    

Build a close working partnership with the Design Team to translate ideas into products.

    

Communicate design ideas effectively to mills and suppliers.

    

Provide feedback on technical feasibility and propose solutions to ensure the vision is translated into product.

Timeline Creation & Management:

    

Plan, coordinate and execute raw material timing for all projects from brief to bulk, in partnership with the Head of Product Development.

    

Ensure adherence to the critical path for design and suppliers to secure deadlines.

    

Identify and mitigate risks and challenges in good time.

Supplier Partnership & Management:

    

Build and maintain effective relationships with all raw material and fabric suppliers, with a working knowledge of their capabilities and supply chains.

    

Ensure all mills and suppliers adhere to Tiger of Sweden's Chemical and Quality Standards, and act as the contact person for related queries.

    

Strengthen partnerships between fabric suppliers and garment manufacturers to secure on-time deliveries and production-ready articles.

    

Act as lead contact for third-party fabric sales partners, supported by the Raw Material Procurement Coordinator.

Fabric Bookings & Delivery Tracking:

    

Create a clear and accurate fabric and trim list at the start of each season, used from development to bulk bookings.

    

Ensure all trials, prototypes, salesman samples and bulk fabric lengths are booked and delivered on time.

    

Work with relevant stakeholders to ensure MasterList data is correct and bulk booking dates are met.

    

Collate end-of-season excess data and work with the Head of Product Development to deplete it in good time.

Quality Testing & Assurance:

    

Own risk assessments, including chemical testing, during collection development.

    

Follow up on physical and chemical testing, interpret reports and take corrective action where needed.

    

Proactively communicate Tiger of Sweden's chemical requirements to suppliers to prevent failures.

    

Participate in quality meetings together with the Head of Product Development.

    

Work closely with the Sustainability Manager to set sustainability guidelines for fibres and fabrics.

Data Integrity:

    

Own all fabric-related data, including technical details, pricing, orders, delivery status, lead times, MOQs, testing and leftovers.

    

Keep PLM/PDM systems updated with full accuracy at all times.

    

Maintain a clear data history by season and collection for reference and archiving.

    

Collect technical sheets from the start of fabric sourcing as the basis for quality testing.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS

    

Strong technical capability and fabric knowledge.

    

Ability to confidently influence and lead Design and Product teams on fabric matters.

    

Proven experience in critical path management for raw materials.

    

Ability to identify risks and recommend mitigating actions.

    

Strong understanding of fabric costing, balancing creativity and commerciality.

    

Expert ability to counter-source fabrics for lead time and price gains.

    

Experience managing supplier relationships.

    

Demonstrated experience working on site with mills.

    

Established contacts within a global fabric supply base.

    

Excellent communication and negotiation skills.

    

Confident working with cross-functional teams.

    

Fashion sensibility, with knowledge of the market and consumer behaviour.

TOOLS & SYSTEMS

    

PLM / PDM systems

    

Excel

The position is based in our Head office in Stockholm and is a full-time position. If this sounds like the perfect fit for you, please don't hesitate to apply by submitting a CV and personal letter in English.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Tiger of Sweden stands against any form of discrimination and strives to be an inclusive brand and workplace. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, race or disability, and recruitment is based purely on skills and experience.

title: ROTA-nanny wanted in Östermalm
description:

During the working week, the nanny will have 24-hour responsibility and accommodation will be provided.

The child attends preschool on weekdays from approximately 9:00 AM–3:00 PM. During preschool hours, the nanny will have time for planning, preparations and other child-related responsibilities.

We are looking to build a reliable nanny team around the family and may therefore be interested in several suitable candidates.

Your Responsibilities:

    Providing attentive and reliable care throughout the working week
    Preparing and cooking meals
    Morning and evening routines
    Bedtime and overnight responsibility
    Caring for the child at home when he is sick or unable to attend preschool
    Planning age-appropriate activities
    Accompanying the family on international trips when required

We are looking for someone who:

    Has extensive previous experience as a nanny
    Is confident taking full responsibility for a 4-year-old child
    Speaks fluent English, preferably at native level
    Is comfortable working a 7-days-on/7-days-off rotational schedule
    Is able to travel internationally and be away for at least two weeks at a time if needed
    Holds an EU passport
    Is flexible, responsible, organized and comfortable with overnight care
    Is interested in a long-term position

Are you interested? Please send us your application via the form below. The job starts as soon as we find the right candidate.

We would love to hear from you!

title: Teacher, Mathematics, Ages 10 - 13
employer: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
description:
Internationella Engelska Skolan Sundbyberg is now seeking a qualified Mathematics teacher as substitute for one of our current Mathematics teachers from March 8th - June 14th 2028. The candidate may have other opportunities to continue working in the school after this period.

We are looking for an enthusiastic, positive, committed and cooperative team-player, willing to go the extra mile for students and colleagues. In addition to teaching meaningful and enjoyable lessons, all staff are expected to be well organised, take pride in their mentorship and other school duties and be outstanding role models for our students. You will be a part of a YearTeam as well as Mathematics Department. You will get support by your colleagues, Head of Year and Head of Department. The Academic Manager will be your mentor the first term.

We require teacher's degree in Sweden or if internationally qualified, a current teaching license/registration.

Main duties include:

• Monitor progress and effectiveness of class work and evaluate and modify as necessary

• Provide a stimulating classroom environment for effective teaching and learning

• Maintain the IES ethos and core values of the school, both inside and outside the classroom

• Report to parents on the development, progress and attainment of students

• Maintain good order and discipline among students, in accordance with the school’s behavior policies

• Mentorship of students in a class in Junior School is included in this position.

Interviews will be held on an on-going basis. The application needs to be sent in to IES Careers.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

title: Projektledare VA & Process
description:
Company description:

Bilfinger is a leading international industrial services provider, driving efficiency and sustainability for the process industry. With 31,000+ employees and over €5.4 billion in revenue in 2025, we offer solutions in consulting, engineering, manufacturing, maintenance, turnarounds, and digital applications across key sectors like energy, chemicals, pharma, and oil & gas.

Bilfinger in the nordic region has more than 3.500 employees in more than 70 locations across Norway, Sweden, Finland and Denmark.

At Bilfinger, we offer a work environment where you can learn and grow. Join us and be part of a team shaping the future!



Job description:

Vill du leda samhällsviktiga projekt inom vatten, avlopp och energi? Här får du möjlighet att utveckla verksamheten och växa i rollen som projektledare.



Om tjänsten

Bilfinger söker nu en projektledare som vill vara med och utveckla och modernisera den samhällsviktiga infrastrukturen i Västsverige. Genom våra ramavtal med flera kommuner i Bohuslän arbetar vi med allt från nybyggnation och ombyggnation av pumpstationer och tryckstegringsstationer till installationer, moderniseringar och underhåll på vattenverk, avloppsreningsverk och värmeverk. Hos oss får du en varierad roll med stort ansvar, nära kundkontakt och möjlighet att påverka hela projektets genomförande från idé till färdig anläggning.



Arbetsuppgifter


    Om- och nybyggnation av pumpstationer  


    Installation och ombyggnation av tryckstegringsstationer för dricksvatten  


    Projekt på vattenverk och avloppsreningsverk  


    Installationer och ombyggnationer på värmeverk  


    Process- och rörinstallationer  


    Samordning av egna montörer, underentreprenörer och leverantörer  


    Kundkontakt och teknisk rådgivning  


    Ansvar för projektens ekonomi, kvalitet och arbetsmiljö  



Kvalifikationer

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du har erfarenhet som Projektledare inom VA, mark och anläggning, industri, bygg, VVS eller processanläggningar. Du behöver ha förmågan att läsa och tolka ritningar, flödesscheman och tekniska beskrivningar. God kunskap inom rörsystem, stålkonstruktioner, mekaniskt montage och svetsade konstruktioner krävs också

    Erfarenhet av VA-anläggningar, pumpstationer, tryckstegringsstationer och vattenreningsanläggningar

Som projektledare hos oss behöver du trivas i en roll där teknik, människor och affär går hand i hand. Du tar ansvar för dina projekt och driver arbetet framåt på ett strukturerat sätt, samtidigt som du har förmågan att anpassa dig när förutsättningarna förändras.

Du gillar att samarbeta och har lätt för att skapa goda relationer med kunder, montörer, underentreprenörer och leverantörer. Du behöver inte kunna allt själv, men du är nyfiken, tekniskt intresserad och bra på att ta hjälp av rätt kompetens för att hitta lösningar.

title: Change Management & Internal Communication Specialist
description:
Company description:

Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:



Are you a hands-on communicator who enjoys working where people, technology, and change come together? This role offers the opportunity to support global HR projects, develop clear communication, and help shape accessible digital experiences across Epiroc.



It all starts with people. People like you.



This is a temporary position until spring 2028.



Your mission

In this role, you will provide support during a period of significant activity across HR communications and digital change. Your mission is to make HR information, tools, and changes easier to understand and use. You will combine hands-on delivery with thoughtful coordination, ensuring that communication is timely, content is reliable, and change management activities remain connected to the needs of employees, managers, and HR colleagues.



Working with HR process owners, project teams, application owners, and regional stakeholders, you will help keep our SharePoint Epiroc HR Portal useful and current while supporting communication and adoption for active HR projects.



Responsibilities include:


    Administer the Epiroc HR Portal and associated SharePoint sites, including pages, news, documents, navigation, permissions, publishing requests, and scheduled content reviews.
    Draft, review, publish, and coordinate HR news, emails, announcements, presentations, guides, newsletters, and other communication materials for defined audiences.
    Maintain change management and communication plans for active HR projects, track actions and deadlines, identify affected groups, and support engagement, training, feedback, readiness, and adoption activities.
    Prepare and update practical change materials such as presentations, FAQs, guides, toolkits, stakeholder information, and ADKAR-based assessments or plans.
    Support UX reviews of prioritized HR applications, portals, forms, dashboards, and user journeys for clarity, accessibility, consistency, and ease of use, and provide actionable recommendations.
    Monitor portal and communication analytics, identify engagement or usability trends, and share basic insights with HR stakeholders.
    Coordinate with content owners and project teams, resolve basic SharePoint questions, and escalate technical, strategic, or scope-related matters to the appropriate owner.



Your profile

You are a collaborative and service-minded communicator who enjoys making complex information clear. You are comfortable working across functions and cultures, following up on details, and balancing several requests without losing sight of the audience. You bring curiosity for digital tools, care about accessible and inclusive experiences, and can move confidently between planning and hands-on delivery.



Required experience:


    Experience in internal communication, corporate communication, employee communication, employer branding, change management communication, or a related field, preferably in a complex international organization.
    Practical SharePoint experience, or strong digital aptitude and the interest to build SharePoint capability quickly; experience with content publishing, governance, and basic analytics is valued.
    Experience supporting organizational change, stakeholder coordination, communication planning, or user-experience reviews, with the ability to create clear materials in English.
    Experience with UX design of applications, identifying usability issues, unclear terminology, unnecessary complexity and other UX issues
    Good working knowledge of Microsoft Copilot



Location and other

The primary location is Sweden (Örebro or Stockholm), however, candidates elsewhere in the EMENA region may also be considered.





Application and contact information

We encourage you to submit your application through our online career site as soon as possible, but no later than October 12, 2026. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before last application date.



We are committed to a thorough recruitment process, including interviews, reference checks and assessments. To ensure a safe working environment, we conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening. Our process is designed to be fair and inclusive; you can expect transparent communication and a balanced evaluation of your skills and experience.



For questions about the position, please contact:

Hiring Manager, Malin Hedlund Borjesson, malin.hedlund.borjesson@epiroc.com

Recruitment Specialist, Zuzana Matova, zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com

title: Affiliated Researcher position at SIR
description:
About the position

As an affiliated researcher joining an existing project, you will be expected to independently and together with the other researchers in the project contribute to:

    Conducting the analysis of a unique, large-scale recruitment database from a major Nordic company, containing applicant-level information across different positions
    Mapping and relating to current research on recruitment, discrimination, and labor market inclusion in Sociology and Management studies
    Conducting the analysis of the data from our survey experiments from a nationally representative sample using the Swedish Citizen Panel. The experiments investigate perceived integration merits of immigrants in Sweden  
    Publishing original research on the basis of the recruitment database and the survey experiment
    Being part of the Center for Migration and Integration Research -CMIR is optional. If you wish to be part of CMIR, you will be expected to participate in the Center’s research activities (e.g. research seminars) and multistakeholder activities (e.g., workshops, roundtables, and dialogue forums)

Your profile

The successful candidate will have built a research agenda during their PhD, as evidenced by publications or conference papers, in the broad field of migration and integration. Their general disciplinary background should be within the social sciences, preferably in sociology or management with a focus on migration and integration. They master quantitative methods and have a very good understanding of survey experiments.

Candidates should thrive in a collaborative environment while driving their contribution to the project independently. The applicants must hold a PhD by time of employment. They have shown ability and ambition to publish manuscripts in highly ranked, international scholarly journals.  We expect the candidate to relocate to Stockholm and to be physically present in the office.

How to apply:

Formal submission will be via the SSE Varbi online platform by latest November 1st, 2026. The following documents should be included in your application:

    A curriculum vitae
    A separate document listing published articles (if any) and articles submitted to journals, as well as other academic peer-reviewed publications (e.g., book chapters, conference proceedings).
    Copies of representative research, that is, copies of your publications or work in progress (max 5)
    Names and contact information for three people willing to provide references.

We recommend that you apply as soon as possible and at the latest before November 1st, 2026. Starting date is flexible but preferably around December 2026. The employment is up to the end of December 2027.

For further questions on the position, please contact Laurence Romani: laurence.romani@hhs.se or Andrea Voyer: Andrea.voyer@sociology.su.se

The position is formally at the Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research

About Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research

Stockholm School of Economics Institute for Research is an independent research foundation, founded in 2010. The overall aim is to conduct qualified academic research within the economic sciences, which aims to unite scientific stringency with empirical relevance. The purpose of the Institute’s publications is to disseminate research concerning corporate enterprises and society.

About the Center for Migration and Integration Research

The Center for Migration and Integration Research (CMIR), housed at the SSE House of Governance and Public Policy (GaPP), aims to create a platform to support the sustainable integration of third-country nationals in Sweden. Together with key stakeholders in the migration and integration process, experiences and insights are researched and incorporated into a systemic perspective. The Center emphasizes the importance of the collaboration of multiple stakeholders in the governance of migration and integration, at multiple levels, and focuses not only on employment, but also on other dimensions of sustainable migration and integration. The research team collects, creates, and disseminates multiple-actor, science-based knowledge on the governance of migration and integration in Sweden for societal and social sustainability.

title: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie 80-100% für die Region Seon gesucht
description:
- Für ein bekanntes Haus im Bereich Pflege und Medizin in der Region Seon suchen wir Sie als Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH – Schwerpunkt Akutpsychiatrie.

### Was Sie über die Stelle in Seon wissen sollten

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Akutpsychiatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Seon

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.

Seon liegt im Kanton Aargau und besticht durch seine zentrale Lage in der Schweiz. Die Region ist dank guter Bahnanbindungen und Autobahnzufahrten hervorragend erreichbar. Als Arbeitsort punktet Seon mit einer ausgewogenen Mischung aus ländlicher Ruhe und wirtschaftlicher Dynamik, wodurch Sie von einem stabilen Arbeitsmarkt und attraktiven Lebensqualität profitieren.

### Ihre Verantwortung als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Seon

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente
- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert
- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Das bringen Sie zwingend mit

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art
- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutpsychiatrie

Sie arbeiten in einem psychiatrischen Umfeld. Beziehung ist hier das wichtigste Werkzeug: Sie begleiten Menschen in Krisen, geben Halt und arbeiten mit klaren Strukturen. Zudem sind Deeskalation und der geschulte Blick für Veränderungen Teil Ihres Alltags – ein Fachbereich, der viel gibt.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Seon verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH tragen die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Somit entsteht Pflegequalität, die ankommt.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Der Arbeitsmarkt für Diplom-Pflegefachpersonen in der Akutpsychiatrie rund um Seon zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, da Fachkräfte in diesem Bereich vielerorts Mangelware sind. Ihre Qualifikation eröffnet Ihnen ausgezeichnete Karrierechancen bei attraktiven Arbeitgeber wie Spitälern und Psychiatrischen Kliniken in der Region. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als etablierter Vermittler mit persönlicher Beratung, umfangreicher Kenntnis des lokalen Arbeitsmarkts und schnellen Kontakten zu renommierten Einrichtungen, wodurch Sie einen nahtlosen Einstieg in eine erfüllende Stelle erleichtern.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Seon

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind
- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag
- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden
- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein
- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen
- Diskretion ist Ehrensache – denn Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutpsychiatrie in Seon

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Übrigens: Laufend weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.

description:
**Operational Technology Integration Lead**

Connecting plant\-floor automation with enterprise data platforms to power the future of biopharmaceutical manufacturing, this role leads the OT integration for the flagship Operations Data Hub Phase 1 in Basel.

This role is primarily based on site in Basel. Working together in person supports close, real\-time collaboration and the technical precision needed to manufacture medicines to the highest quality and safety standards. We offer flexibility to work remotely/and other sites. Requests are considered on a case\-by\-case basis, in line with business needs.

**What you will get:**

* An agile career and dynamic working culture.
* An inclusive and ethical workplace.


**What you will do:**

* Drive the core data integration strategy that connects plant\-floor automation directly into Lonza's Operations Data Hub (ODH).
* Lead matrixed execution across site automation teams, global engineering, system integrators, and vendors such as Emerson.
* Deliver production\-grade integrations across DeltaV DCS, Syncade MES, AVEVA PI Historian, and LIMS environments.
* Direct the technical configuration of Ignition, HiveMQ, MQTT brokers, UDTs, and OT data interfaces.
* Own source\-to\-target mapping for complex manufacturing context including batches, materials, equipment, and recipes.
* Mentor project resources and establish reusable, version\-controlled OT integration standards and DevSecOps release patterns.
* Lead OT connectivity assessments within the Cross\-Platform Network Assessment to shape future global rollout blueprints.


**What we are looking for:**

* Extensive experience (10\+ years) in Operational Technology (OT) integration and digital manufacturing architectures.
* Proven technical mastery of industrial control systems including DeltaV DCS, Syncade MES, and AVEVA PI Historian.
* Hands\-on expertise with industrial data platforms, edge architectures, MQTT, HiveMQ brokers, and Ignition configurations.
* Strong knowledge of ISA\-88 / ISA\-95 standards, data mapping, and bridging OT/IT boundary systems.
* Demonstrated experience working within regulated GMP environments, applying CSV/CSA and data integrity standards.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Excellent collaborative leadership skills with business fluent English communication.


**About Lonza**

At Lonza, their people are their greatest strength. With 30\+ sites across five continents, their globally connected teams work together every day to manufacture the medicines of tomorrow.

Their core values of Collaboration, Accountability, Excellence, Passion and Integrity reflect who they are and how they work together. Everyone’s ideas, big or small, have the potential to improve millions of lives, and that’s the kind of work they want you to be part of. Innovation thrives when people from all backgrounds bring their unique perspectives to the table. At Lonza, they value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment.

As Lonza’s talent acquisition partner, please note, Randstad is responsible for the engagement and contracting of this contingent role. Ready to play your part in shaping the future of life sciences? Apply now.

### Auf einen Blick: Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH für die Region Brugg

**Position:** Dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF/FH

**Fachbereich:** Gerontopsychiatrie

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellungsart:** Festanstellung

**Einsatzbeginn:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Brugg

**Arbeitgeber:** Pflegeheim – den Namen erfahren Sie im Gespräch

Brugg liegt zentral in der Nordwestschweiz und besticht durch seine hervorragende Verkehrsanbindung mit direkten Bahnverbindungen nach Zürich und Basel. Die historische Stadt an der Aare bietet Ihnen ein attraktives Arbeitsumfeld mit guter Infrastruktur, zahlreichen lokalen Arbeitgebern und einer hohen Lebensqualität. Die Nähe zu grösseren Wirtschaftszentren macht Brugg zum idealen Arbeitsort für pendelnde Fachkräfte.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in der Gerontopsychiatrie in Brugg

- Verantwortung für den gesamten Pflegeprozess von der Bedarfserhebung bis zur Auswertung
- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Vorbereitung und Abgabe der Medikamente
- Überwachung von Vitalzeichen und frühzeitiges Erkennen von Zustandsveränderungen
- Fachliche Anleitung von FaGe, Pflegeassistenz und Lernenden im Team
- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen Pflegesystem
- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien und Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe
- Darüber hinaus Mitgestaltung von Pflegekonzepten sowie wir verbessern die Qualität stetig im Team
- Validierende Begleitung von Menschen mit Demenz, Depression oder Delir
- Deeskalation bei herausforderndem Verhalten sowie aktive Angehörigenarbeit

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH
- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich
- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha
- Vor allem hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Empathie und Belastbarkeit
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. Niveau B2)
- Erfahrung oder grosses Interesse im Fachbereich Gerontopsychiatrie

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Gerontopsychiatrie

Der Fachbereich Gerontopsychiatrie verbindet Pflege mit Psychiatrie im Alter. Sie begleiten vor allem Menschen mit Demenz, Depression oder Delir und unterscheiden ausserdem diese Krankheitsbilder sicher. Dabei arbeiten Sie mit validierenden Gesprächstechniken, deeskalieren herausforderndes Verhalten und gestalten ein reizarmes, sicheres Umfeld. Ausserdem beziehen Sie Angehörige aktiv ein, denn Vertrauen ist in diesem Fachbereich die wichtigste Grundlage.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau oder Pflegefachmann in der Gerontopsychiatrie vereinen Sie Pflegekompetenz mit psychiatrischem Fachwissen. Darum zählt die Pflegefachfrau in der Gerontopsychiatrie in Brugg zu den gefragtesten Profilen der Schweiz.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Die fachliche Verantwortung im gesamten Pflegeprozess liegt bei den diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen HF/FH. Sie erheben zum Beispiel den Pflegebedarf, planen anschliessend die Massnahmen, führen sie durch und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern sie die Medikamentenabgabe, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen im Gesundheitszustand frühzeitig. Dadurch sichern sie die Pflegequalität für jede einzelne Bewohnerin und jeden Bewohner.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die dreijährige höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium in Pflege an einer Fachhochschule (FH). Beide Abschlüsse berechtigen zur eigenverantwortlichen Berufsausübung. Ausländische Diplome benötigen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen attraktive Weiterbildungen offen, etwa ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Funktion als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.

Die Nachfrage nach diplomierten Pflegefachpersonen mit Spezialisierung auf Gerontopsychiatrie ist in der Region Brugg weiterhin sehr hoch, da die alternde Bevölkerung eine kontinuierlich steigende Betreuung in diesem Bereich erfordert. Sie profitieren von hervorragenden Karrierechancen mit attraktiven Positionen in Spitälern, Pflegezentren und psychiatrischen Einrichtungen, bei denen 80–100%-Stellen Standard sind. iPersonal unterstützt Sie als spezialisierter Vermittler mit umfassender Marktkenntnis und etablierten Kontakten zu renommierten Arbeitgebern, wodurch Sie schneller und gezielter zur passenden Position gelangen.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Brugg

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – so wächst Ihre Karriere weiter

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau/-mann in der Gerontopsychiatrie in Brugg

**Welche Ausbildung benötige ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit einer SRK-Anerkennung ebenfalls willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Brauche ich bereits Erfahrung in der Gerontopsychiatrie?**
Erfahrung ist zwar ein Vorteil, aber keine Bedingung. Entscheidend sind echtes Interesse am Fachbereich und die Bereitschaft, sich einzuarbeiten – Weiterbildung wird gefördert.

**Was unterscheidet die Gerontopsychiatrie von der klassischen Langzeitpflege?**
Die Gerontopsychiatrie verbindet Pflege mit Psychiatrie im Alter. Sie begleiten gezielt Menschen mit Demenz, Depression oder Delir und arbeiten mit validierenden und deeskalierenden Methoden.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
Sie erhalten in der Regel innert 24 Stunden eine Antwort – denn Warten ist verlorene Zeit. Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir dabei streng vertraulich.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, natürlich: Im persönlichen Gespräch erfahren Sie sofort, um welche Institution es geht. Im Inserat verzichten wir jedoch aus Diskretionsgründen darauf.

Chef\-fe d’équipe – Secteur voirie
=======================================

Établissement autonome de droit public de la République et Canton de Neuchâtel, établi sur plusieurs sites de services et fort d’une soixantaine de collaborateurs, répartis principalement dans les secteurs *voirie* et *équipements d’exploitation et de sécurité*, NEVIA (Neuchâtel Établissement pour la Viabilité des Infrastructures Autoroutières) assure l’exploitation et l’entretien courant des axes autoroutiers N5 – Yverdon\-Bienne et N20 \- Le Locle – Anet.



**Activités :**

À la tête d’une équipe d'environ 10 cantonniers(ères)\-chauffeurs(res), vous assurez l’organisation, la coordination et le suivi des activités d’entretien du réseau routier. En qualité de chef\-fe d’équipe, vous exercez un rôle de **management de proximité**.

Vous encadrez et accompagnez votre équipe au quotidien, veillez au bon fonctionnement collectif et contribuez à la mise en œuvre des orientations, règles et décisions de l’établissement.

À ce titre, vos principales missions sont notamment :

* planifier à court et moyen terme les activités et missions confiées à votre équipe et participer à leur organisation à moyen terme ;
* organiser et distribuer quotidiennement le travail et transmettre des consignes claires ;
* assurer le management quotidien de votre équipe, mobiliser et responsabiliser les collaborateurs et contribuer au développement de leur autonomie ;
* donner des feedbacks réguliers, reconnaître les contributions et intervenir de manière constructive lorsque des ajustements ou recadrages sont nécessaires ;
* favoriser un climat de travail constructif et respectueux et contribuer à la gestion des situations relationnelles ou organisationnelles au sein de l’équipe ;
* assurer le suivi et contrôler la bonne exécution des travaux réalisés ;veiller au respect et à l’application des règles, procédures, directives et décisions de l’établissement ;
* veiller au respect des règles et consignes de sécurité ;
* organiser et contrôler la pose et le retrait de la signalisation temporaire ;
* assurer la surveillance du réseau routier et de ses abords ;
* organiser et participer aux interventions nécessaires à la remise en état des infrastructures, notamment à la suite d’accidents ;
* participer à la formation, à l’intégration et au développement des collaborateurs ;
* coordonner certaines interventions réalisées par des entreprises ou prestataires externes;
* collaborer étroitement avec le voyer\-chef, les autres chefs d’équipe, le chef d'équipe principal et la direction, contribuer aux échanges et assurer une bonne circulation de l’information ;
* participer activement à la coordination des activités du secteur voirie et proposer des améliorations dans son fonctionnement ;
* accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles et opérationnelles de l’établissement, en expliquer le sens et contribuer à leur mise en œuvre auprès de votre équipe ;
* prendre part au service d’astreinte.




**Profil requis:**

* CFC ou titre équivalent ;
* titulaire du permis de conduire poids lourds ;
* expérience de plusieurs années dans les travaux de voirie ou de chantier ;
* expérience avérée dans la conduite d’une équipe et capacité démontrée à exercer un leadership de proximité ;
* leadership affirmé et constructif, avec la capacité à mobiliser, responsabiliser et faire progresser les collaborateurs ;
* bonnes capacités d’organisation, de planification et de prise de décision;
* capacité à donner et recevoir du feedback ainsi qu’à gérer de manière constructive les situations humaines ou relationnelles délicates ;
* capacité à poser un cadre clair et à faire respecter les règles, directives et décisions avec cohérence et discernement ;
* communication claire, constructive et adaptée aux différents interlocuteurs ;
* sens des responsabilités, exemplarité et capacité à prendre du recul ;
* esprit de collaboration et capacité à travailler de manière constructive avec sa hiérarchie, ses pairs et les autres secteurs de l’établissement ;
* capacité à porter les décisions prises, à en expliquer le sens et à accompagner leur mise en œuvre auprès de l’équipe ;
* ouverture, adaptabilité et capacité à accompagner les changements et les évolutions de l’établissement ;
* capacité à travailler avec des horaires variables et à faire preuve de flexibilité ;
* maîtrise des outils bureautiques usuels (Word, Excel et Outlook) ;
* domicile proche du lieu de travail (environ 15 à 20 minutes).


**Entrée en fonction :** 1 décembre ou à convenir

title: IT Operations Engineer
description:
IT Operations Engineer

Based in Lucerne and London, and powered by a team representing 30\+ nationalities, our culture is defined by our ambition, adaptability, collaboration, and an unshakeable commitment to excellence.  
IT Operations Engineer  
The IT Solutions team  
As part of the Commercial Services department, the IT Solutions team keeps TEAM digitally connected, secure and running smoothly. We manage the technology foundations that enable the business to operate effectively while continually improving our infrastructure, security and digital workplace. IT Solutions ensures that TEAM's core technology services are resilient, secure and scalable. From managing cloud infrastructure and cybersecurity to overseeing devices, vendors and technology operations, we provide the trusted platforms that enable our people to collaborate confidently and deliver exceptional work.  
The role  
As IT Operations Engineer, you will be responsible for the operational management of TEAM's technology estate. You will ensure that infrastructure, security, end\-user technology and technology suppliers operate reliably, securely and efficiently while continually improving the services provided to the closely with colleagues across IT, Data and Innovation, you will provide the operational foundation that enables TEAM's technology strategy to succeed. Your responsibilities will include the following:  
Technology operations \& service management  
Ensure the availability, performance and security of TEAM’s IT systems and services, including Microsoft365, Microsoft Entra ID, Azure and related cloud services.  
Monitor IT systems and manage incidents, problems and changes to minimise downtime and improve service quality.  
Infrastructure, security \& resilience  
Manage and improve TEAM's IT infrastructure, including networks, cloud services, hybrid environments, storage, backup, disaster recovery and business continuity.  
Maintain a strong security environment by managing identity and access, network security, vulnerability management, patching, endpoint protection, security monitoring and incident response.  
End user technology \& supplier management  
Manage end\-user devices and IT assets throughout their lifecycle, including purchasing, deployment, maintenance and secure disposal.  
Work with technology vendors, software suppliers and managed service providers to ensure reliable services.  
Governance \& continuous improvement  
Create and maintain technical documentation, standards, policies and procedures that support security, compliance and business continuity.  
Support IT budgeting, software licensing, audits and regulatory compliance.  
Help develop and deliver the Technology Operations roadmap by improving infrastructure, expanding cloud services, introducing automation and continuously improving IT services.  
Leadership  
Provide technical guidance and support to colleagues while promoting teamwork, continuous improvement and excellent customer service.  
The candidate  
You have experience as a System Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer or Network Engineer in an enterprise environment and are ready to apply your hands\-on expertise of Microsoft technologies, hybrid environments and virtual server infrastructure. You have a good understanding of IT infrastructure, cloud technologies and cybersecurity, and are confident supporting and improving IT systems. You are organised, take responsibility for your work and enjoy solving technical challenges.  
Additionally, you shine in the following areas:  
Adaptability: You embrace new technologies and continually seek opportunities to modernise and improve operational services.  
Ambition: You strive for operational excellence and encourage continuous improvement across technology services and technical knowledge.  
Connection: You build trusted relationships with colleagues, suppliers and business stakeholders, communicating technical concepts clearly.  
Diligence: You demonstrate exceptional attention to detail, ensuring technology services remain secure, reliable and well :You speak and write in English \& German.  
We offer  
At TEAM, our aim is to be the best place to develop a career in the sports marketing industry. We do this by cultivating a TEAM community that allows all staff to thrive, promoting clear and transparent communication and focusing on individual development.  
Be inspired: Work with and learn from industry\-leading professionals in an open, international and vibrant culture.  
Continue growing: Benefit from regular and customised training and coaching programmes.  
Work flexibly: Our hybrid policy balances in\-office and remote work on a weekly basis, allows the option of working elsewhere for up to 4 weeks per year, includes at least 5 weeks’ holiday, plus public holidays and an end\-of\-year office closure.  
Get involved: Join TEAM’s Sustainability, DEI or Social committees; participate in weekly staff\-organised sports; contribute to regular volunteering/charity opportunities; enjoy all\-company events and celebrations.  
Enjoy extras: Take advantage of a discounted annual gym membership, onboarding support and commuter benefits.  
The position will be based at TEAM’s HQ in Lucerne, Switzerland and will involve some international travel.

137385 \| 80 \- 100% \| Oerlikon, Zürich \| Hybrid

Working at METTLER TOLEDO AutoChem Inc. ( means you are impacting the world in important ways. Our process analytical technology and automated synthesis reactors provide scientists in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and chemical industries the information they need to deliver life\-changing products. **Drive the next generation of laboratory innovation!**

In this critical leadership role, you will define and execute the global R\&D strategy for the **Automated Chemistry business unit**, leading the development of innovative hardware and software solutions that empower scientists and engineers worldwide.

As a member of the AutoChem Functional Management Committee (FMC), you will shape the future technology roadmap, foster a culture of innovation, and ensure the successful delivery of new products that create sustainable customer value and business growth. * Partner closely with Strategic Product Groups to ensure alignment of R\&D roadmaps, investment priorities, and business objectives.

* Own the global R\&D budget, and project roadmap, ensuring effective resource allocation, investment decisions and organizational alignment to maximize innovation impact and business value
* Serve as a key member of the AutoChem Functional Management Committee (FMC), fostering strong partnerships across Product Management, Quality, Operations, Commercial organizations, Digital Business Services, and external technology partners to drive business success.

Infirmier(ère) en Néonatologie (H/F)
======================================





  
Manpower, leader des solutions efficaces et innovantes pour l'emploi, met en  
  
relation les meilleurs talents du marché avec les entreprises recherchant des compétences précises.  
  
Chaque année, 5'000 clients dans tous les secteurs d'activité et 20'000 candidats nous font confiance.  
  
Avec plus de 400 collaborateurs internes et 60 filiales, Manpower Suisse est ancré dans toutes les régions linguistiques.





Nous recrutons actuellement plusieurs infirmier(e)s (H/F) pour des missions ponctuelles au sein du département de **Néonatologie.**  

Ces postes offrent l'opportunité d'évoluer dans un environnement hospitalier reconnu et exigeant, au coeur du canton de Vaud.  

  **Votre mission :**  

Vous intervenez notamment dans :  


* La prise en charge des nouveau\-nés, prématurés ou nécessitant une surveillance spécifique  
* La surveillance continue des fonctions vitales et l'évolution clinique des nourrissons  
* La réalisation de soins techniques spécialisés (alimentation, perfusions, assistance respiratoire, etc.)  
* L'accompagnement et le soutien des parents dans un contexte souvent délicat  
* La participation au développement du lien parent\-enfant  
* La collaboration étroite avec l'équipe médicale et pluridisciplinaire  
  
  **Votre profil :**  


*      Diplôme d'infirmier/ère HES **/** ou Diplôme dans dans un pays de la Communauté Européenne

  

*      Reconnaissance obligatoire auprès de la Croix\- suisse

  

*       **Minimum 24 mois d'expérience en soins aigus de type CHU ou CHR, réduit à 12mois si diplôme HES Suisse**

  

*      Expérience en **néonatologie** un atout

  

*      Intérêt marqué pour la santé de la femme et la périnatalité

  

*      Excellentes compétences relationnelles et esprit d'équipe

  

*      Sens des responsabilités, autonomie et organisation

  

*      Bonne capacité d'adaptation dans un environnement dynamique
