Office Administrator
====================

**JOB DESCRIPTION – OFFICE ADMINISTRATOR**



**Location: Zürich**

**Division: Ticketmaster Central Europe Market, Switzerland**

**Manager: Managing Director, Switzerland**

**Contract Terms: 80\-100%, Full Time 42\.5 hours per week**



**THE JOB**


You are the organisational backbone of Ticketmaster Switzerland and run our office in Dübendorf to a high standard. You keep the market's administrative processes running, supporting Finance, HR and Customer Service, and you own our Experience Management, VIP guests, lounges, complimentary tickets and invitations.

In addition, you keep calendars, meetings and deadlines on track and provide administrative support to the Managing Director.




**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**



Office Management



* Run the office to a high standard, supplies, mail, keys/keycards, parking and pool car, visitor welcome.
* Liaise with the landlord and external contractors, oversee facility topics and health \& safety.
* Maintain office policies, internal manuals and process documentation.
* Organise team events and maintain the team vacation and absence overview.




Team Support



* Support HR administration, on\-/offboarding, personnel files, coordination with insurance and payroll partners, in collaboration with the global HR Operations team.
* Support Finance with preparatory accounting, support in digitalising accounting processes, and payment follow\-ups.
* Contract and vendor management, deadlines, filing and coordination with external vendors.
* Maintain the weekly event outlook so all functions can plan ahead.
* Support the team with administrative tasks and cross\-department coordination.
* Ad\-hoc tasks and projects as required.




Experience Management



* Manage VIP guests, lounges and hospitality at concerts, festivals and sports events.
* Administer complimentary tickets, invitations and guest lists for clients and partners.
* Coordinate hospitality logistics with promoters and venues.
* Organise internal occasions (e.g. employee events and recognition).




Administrative Support \& Coordination



* Manage the Managing Director's calendar and inbox, prioritise and schedule with foresight.
* Prepare meetings, briefings and presentations (Management Team meetings, Town Halls), take minutes and manage follow\-ups.
* Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines and follow up proactively.
* Plan and book travel and handle expense reporting for the team and the Managing Director.
* First point of contact for internal and external requests, handling confidential matters with discretion.




**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)**



* Experience as an office manager, executive assistant or in a comparable organisational role.
* Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, calm and structured under multiple demands.
* High discretion and reliability in handling confidential information.
* Advanced Outlook and MS Office skills.
* Fluent and English; French is a plus.
* Affinity for live entertainment and hosting, willingness to attend selected evening/weekend events.
* Proactive, hands\-on and service\-minded personality.




YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)



* You are a highly organised, proactive and dependable professional who enjoys being the trusted go\-to person in a fast\-moving environment.
* You anticipate needs, bring structure to complex priorities and follow through reliably, even when several stakeholders and deadlines compete for attention.
* You communicate with confidence, warmth and tact at all levels—from senior leadership and external partners to colleagues across the business.
* You handle confidential information with sound judgement, absolute discretion and a strong sense of ownership.
* You are service\-minded and naturally create positive experiences for colleagues, clients and VIP guests, with a genuine eye for detail.
* You remain calm, flexible and solutions\-oriented under pressure, especially around events and changing schedules.
* You enjoy working independently while being a collaborative, hands\-on team player who is happy to step in wherever support is needed.
* You take pride in creating an efficient, welcoming and well\-run office environment.
* You have an affinity for live entertainment and enjoy contributing to memorable experiences for fans, partners and the team.




LIFE AT TICKETMASTER



We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.



Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.



We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.



**Our work is guided by our values:**



**Reliability** \- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.



**Teamwork** \- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team



**Integrity** \- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent



**Belonging** \- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive



EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES



We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.



HIRING PRACTICES


The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.



Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.



\#TMSwitzerland

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

Global Head of R\&D \| Automated Chemistry
==========================================





**About**

Working at METTLER TOLEDO AutoChem Inc. ( ) means you are impacting the world in important ways. Our process analytical technology and automated synthesis reactors provide scientists in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and chemical industries the information they need to deliver life\-changing products. As a strategic business unit within , AutoChem develops, manufactures, sells, and services instruments that modernize chemical synthesis, provide insight to every chemical reaction, and provide process knowledge to eliminate scale\-up and safety incidents. * Our instruments increase the efficiency and effectiveness of chemists and engineers.
* Our products help develop profitable, green, and safe scientific processes.
* We help keep you healthy. Our instruments make it possible for scientists to develop new drugs and bring life\-saving medicines to the world.



  
**Our Opening and Your Responsibilities**



**Drive the next generation of laboratory innovation!**





In this critical leadership role, you will define and execute the global R\&D strategy for the **Automated Chemistry business unit**, leading the development of innovative hardware and software solutions that empower scientists and engineers worldwide.





As a member of the AutoChem Functional Management Committee (FMC), you will shape the future technology roadmap, foster a culture of innovation, and ensure the successful delivery of new products that create sustainable customer value and business growth. Leading a highly skilled global R\&D organization across multiple disciplines and locations, you will combine strategic leadership with strong technical engagement to keep AutoChem at the forefront of laboratory automation and process innovation







In this role, your responsibilities will include:





* Own the global R\&D strategy and technology roadmap, aligning innovation priorities, technology investments, and organizational capabilities with AutoChem's long\-term business objectives.
* Lead a global R\&D organization spanning hardware development, software development, systems engineering, systems testing, and project management across multiple locations.
* Drive the development of innovative hardware and software solutions that strengthen AutoChem's market position and enable sustainable business growth.
* a culture of innovation and engineering excellence while continuously evaluating emerging technologies, industry trends, and future technology platforms to unlock long\-term customer and business value.
* Ensure effective execution of global product development programs, balancing robust product lifecycle management processes with the agility required to accelerate innovation and time\-to\-market.
* Partner closely with Strategic Product Groups to ensure alignment of R\&D roadmaps, investment priorities, and business objectives.
* Act as a visible "working leader," providing both strategic direction and technical guidance while supporting teams in solving complex engineering and technology challenges.
* Build and lead a high\-performing global R\&D organization by defining its vision, operating model, priorities, and ways of working while continuously strengthening technical, leadership, and organizational capabilities.
* Own the global R\&D budget, and project roadmap, ensuring effective resource allocation, investment decisions and organizational alignment to maximize innovation impact and business value
* Serve as a key member of the AutoChem Functional Management Committee (FMC), fostering strong partnerships across Product Management, Quality, Operations, Commercial organizations, Digital Business Services, and external technology partners to drive business success.

**What You Need to Succeed**

The following requirements are necessary for this role:





* Master's degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Computer Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A PhD is an advantage.
* 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in R\&D, Engineering, Product Development, or related technical disciplines.
* Proven experience leading global multidisciplinary development organizations across hardware, software, automation, systems engineering, and related technology domains.
* Demonstrated success in developing and commercializing complex technology products within industrial automation, semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, analytical instrumentation, laboratory automation, process technology, or comparable technology\-driven environments.
* Strong technical leadership capabilities with the ability to engage deeply in engineering and technology discussions while providing strategic direction to highly experienced subject matter experts.
* Demonstrated success leading technical experts, engineering managers, and multidisciplinary teams across multiple locations, functions, and technology platforms.
* Proven experience defining and executing technology strategies, innovation roadmaps, and organizational transformation initiatives in a global environment.
* Strong understanding of integrated product ecosystems combining hardware, software, automation, digital solutions, and service offerings.
* Demonstrated success partnering with and influencing senior leadership, driving alignment and execution across complex global matrix organizations.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing significant R\&D investments, budgets, and portfolio prioritization decisions. Experience with ownership of a substantial functional budget is highly desirable.
* A balance of strategic thinking and hands\-on execution, with the ability to translate technology opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
* Native\-level or business fluent English, written and spoken; additional languages are considered an asset.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 25\-30%.



**Our Offer to You**



* Where applicable flexible working hours, a hybrid work model and a wide portfolio of training opportunities
* 40h week with at least 25 vacation days per year plus 4 to 7 additional days off (i.e. in between bank holidays)
* Free parking spaces and direct access to public transport from our facilities
* Healthy menus cooked onsite and special prices for employees at our own METTLER TOLEDO restaurant
* We offer a dynamic and innovation\-driven corporate culture that promotes teamwork, personal development, and a passion for excellence.
* A range of additional attractive benefits like discounts for sport clubs and others


You can expect challenging, interesting, and varied tasks in an innovative and international environment, with the opportunity to network globally and realize your next career goal.

GE \- Gérant\-e technique en immobilier
========================================

Les valeurs d’**engagement**, d’**innovation**, de communauté d’**autonomie** et de **plaisir** vous animent ? Venez leur donner tout leur sens en rejoignant  **Immobilier** !

Animés par une démarche foncièrement durable, nos 500 collaborateurs, répartis dans 10 agences, s’engagent chaque jour afin de construire un futur responsable en déployant leur **expertise** et leur **dynamisme** à travers tous les métiers de l’immobilier : du pilotage de promotions immobilières à la gérance, en passant par le courtage, l’administration de PPE, l’immobilier commercial et d’investissement. Nos filiales complètent cette offre grâce à leurs services d’expertise immobilière, de réalisation et de suivi de projets architecturaux.

Intégrez aujourd’hui une équipe accueillante, humaine et créative !



### Pour notre agence de Genève, nous recherchons un\-e :

Gérant\-e technique immobilier
-------------------------------

**Vos missions :**

Accompagné\-e de votre assistant\-e, vous assurez la maintenance technique optimale et la valorisation des bâtiments/objets sous gestion, dans l’intérêt des propriétaires et pour le confort des locataires. Pour ce faire, vous assurez les missions suivantes :

* Assurer la bonne communication avec votre assistant\-e, la répartition de la charge de travail, la qualité du travail et le respect des délais,
* Réaliser les états des lieux préliminaires, d’entrée et de sortie, et transmettre les informations relatives à ces états des lieux aux assistant\-e\-s pour l’établissement des bons de travaux,
* Être la personne de contact avec les concierges, établir leur cahier des charges et les rapports techniques des immeubles,
* Suivre la relation locataires pour les problèmes techniques et les réclamations écrites,
* Réaliser les travaux d’entretien courant et suivre la facturation,
* Gérer les sinistres et les contrats de maintenance,
* Etablir les budgets immeubles,
* Réaliser les travaux de rénovation pour les appartements et les immeubles,
* Mettre en conformité les objets selon l’évolution de la législation.


**Votre profil :**

* Vous pouvez justifier d’une expérience réussie dans une régie en Suisse d’au moins 5 ans et avez une bonne connaissance de la technique du bâtiment ou de l’entretien,
* Vous êtes au bénéfice d’un CFC ou d’une Maturité commerciale ou d’une formation en technique du bâtiment et avait effectué une formation complémentaire dans l'immobilier (Immobase / Immotechnique),
* Vous savez gérer le suivi des travaux et des sinistres,
* Au bénéfice d’une excellente présentation, vous êtes organisé\-e et vous aimez le contact avec la clientèle et les entreprises,
* Vous êtes à l’aise avec les outils informatiques (Word, Excel) et avez déjà travaillé avec le logiciel Quorum,
* Vous vous exprimez parfaitement en français et avait de bonnes connaissances en anglais,
* Vous faites preuve d’initiatives et démontrez une très bonne organisation.


**Nous offrons :**

* L’opportunité de rejoindre un acteur majeur de l’immobilier suisse à la pointe de l’innovation,
* Un environnement de travail moderne et agréable,
* Un accompagnement personnalisé et des formations continues pour développer votre expertise,
* Un management accessible, bienveillant et à l’écoute,
* Une prévoyance professionnelle et des prestations sociales avantageuses,
* Une semaine sur 4,5 jours possible avec le vendredi après\-midi disponible,
* La possibilité de télétravail
* Des horaires flexibles pour préserver votre équilibre vie professionnelle / vie privée
* Des événements internes et une culture d’entreprise favorisant l’esprit d’équipe et la convivialité


**Taux d’activité** : 100%

**Entrée en fonction** : Dès que possible

title: Responsable Points de Vente
description:
Ref 2582453 \| Date: 2 Oct 2026

![TRAVYS SA]( )

Dans le cadre de la création de **movodis SA**, issue du rapprochement de TRAVYS, MBC et LEB ou la diversité est au cœur de nos valeurs : nous encourageons l’inclusion et garantissons l’égalité professionnelle. Pour renforcer notre équipe, nous recherchons actuellement notre futur·e





**Responsable Points de Vente**

Rattaché·e au/à le/la Responsable Vente et Distribution, vous assurez le pilotage opérationnel des points de vente et veillez à la bonne mise en œuvre des processus de vente et de distribution au sein de ceux\-ci et sur l’ensemble du périmètre de movodis SA.



Vous êtes garant·e de la qualité de l’accueil et du conseil à la clientèle, de la bonne application des procédures de vente et d’encaissement ainsi que du bon fonctionnement quotidien des points de vente. Présent·e sur le terrain, vous accompagnez les équipes et contribuez à la mise en œuvre des orientations définies par le service Vente et Distribution.



### **Vos responsabilités**



* **Manager et accompagner les équipes** : encadrer, organiser et développer les compétences des collaborateur·rice·s des points de vente. Vous assurez la gestion opérationnelle des équipes, accompagnez leur développement professionnel et veillez à une organisation efficace du travail sur les différents sites ;
* **Piloter les points de vente** : superviser leur fonctionnement quotidien et garantir la qualité de l’accueil, du conseil et du service à la clientèle. Vous veillez à l’application des procédures de vente, des systèmes de vente et d’encaissement ainsi qu’à la disponibilité des produits, supports et équipements nécessaires à l’activité ;
* **Garantir la qualité et la performance** : suivre les indicateurs d’activité, identifier les besoins et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires. Vous contribuez à l’amélioration continue des processus et de l’expérience client ;
* **Déployer la stratégie Vente et Distribution** : mettre en œuvre les orientations et objectifs définis par le service, accompagner les évolutions liées aux produits, tarifs et systèmes de vente et assurer leur bonne compréhension par les équipes ;
* **Fédérer et coordonner** : assurer une présence régulière sur les différents sites, favoriser une culture de service orientée client et collaborer avec les services concernés, notamment la relation clientèle, le contrôle des titres de transport et les filiales.


### **Votre profil**



* CFC d’employé·e de commerce ou formation jugée équivalente, complété idéalement par une formation en management ;
* Minimum 5 ans d’expérience confirmée dans la vente ou la relation clientèle ;
* Expérience confirmée en management d’équipe, idéalement dans un environnement multisite ;
* Une expérience dans les transports publics ou dans un environnement fortement orienté clientèle ;
* Bonne connaissance des produits et systèmes de vente des transports publics ainsi que des processus de distribution et d’encaissement ;
* Maîtrise des outils informatiques usuels et des systèmes de vente ; une connaissance du fonctionnement tarifaire Mobilis constitue un atout ;
* Leadership de proximité, sens du service client et excellente communication ;
* Capacité à fédérer et accompagner des équipes réparties sur plusieurs sites ;
* Organisation, autonomie et sens des responsabilités ;
* Résistance au stress et aisance dans un environnement dynamique.


### **Ce que nous vous offrons**



Rejoindre **movodis SA**, c’est participer à la construction d’une nouvelle entreprise de transports publics et contribuer concrètement à l’évolution de la mobilité dans la région.



Nous vous offrons une fonction à forte responsabilité, alliant vision stratégique et pilotage opérationnel, au cœur de projets variés et stimulants. Vous aurez l’opportunité de participer à la création et au développement d’une nouvelle organisation, dans un environnement collaboratif engagé en faveur d’une mobilité durable.



Vous jouerez un rôle central dans la construction de movodis SA et dans le développement de nouvelles solutions de mobilité, tant pour les marchés conventionnés que pour de nouveaux segments d'activité. Au\-delà d'un projet, nous vous proposons l'opportunité de participer à la construction d'une organisation tournée vers l'avenir et de contribuer concrètement à son succès.  

Vous bénéficierez également de conditions de travail attractives, permettant de concilier engagement professionnel et équilibre personnel.



### **Intéressé·e ?**



Vous souhaitez mettre votre expertise des transports publics et votre capacité à piloter des projets stratégiques au service du développement de la mobilité de demain ? Nous nous réjouissons de recevoir votre dossier de candidature complet (CV, lettre de motivation, diplômes et certificats de travail) via Jobup jusqu'au 31 octobre 2026\.



**movodis SA se réjouit de faire votre connaissance !**

Office Administrator
====================

**JOB DESCRIPTION – OFFICE ADMINISTRATOR**



**Location: Zürich**

**Division: Ticketmaster Central Europe Market, Switzerland**

**Manager: Managing Director, Switzerland**

**Contract Terms: 80\-100%, Full Time 42\.5 hours per week**



**THE JOB**


You are the organisational backbone of Ticketmaster Switzerland and run our office in Dübendorf to a high standard. You keep the market's administrative processes running, supporting Finance, HR and Customer Service, and you own our Experience Management, VIP guests, lounges, complimentary tickets and invitations.

In addition, you keep calendars, meetings and deadlines on track and provide administrative support to the Managing Director.




**WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING**



Office Management



* Run the office to a high standard, supplies, mail, keys/keycards, parking and pool car, visitor welcome.
* Liaise with the landlord and external contractors, oversee facility topics and health \& safety.
* Maintain office policies, internal manuals and process documentation.
* Organise team events and maintain the team vacation and absence overview.




Team Support



* Support HR administration, on\-/offboarding, personnel files, coordination with insurance and payroll partners, in collaboration with the global HR Operations team.
* Support Finance with preparatory accounting, support in digitalising accounting processes, and payment follow\-ups.
* Contract and vendor management, deadlines, filing and coordination with external vendors.
* Maintain the weekly event outlook so all functions can plan ahead.
* Support the team with administrative tasks and cross\-department coordination.
* Ad\-hoc tasks and projects as required.




Experience Management



* Manage VIP guests, lounges and hospitality at concerts, festivals and sports events.
* Administer complimentary tickets, invitations and guest lists for clients and partners.
* Coordinate hospitality logistics with promoters and venues.
* Organise internal occasions (e.g. employee events and recognition).




Administrative Support \& Coordination



* Manage the Managing Director's calendar and inbox, prioritise and schedule with foresight.
* Prepare meetings, briefings and presentations (Management Team meetings, Town Halls), take minutes and manage follow\-ups.
* Track open tasks, decisions and deadlines and follow up proactively.
* Plan and book travel and handle expense reporting for the team and the Managing Director.
* First point of contact for internal and external requests, handling confidential matters with discretion.




**WHAT YOU NEED TO KNOW (or TECHNICAL SKILLS)**



* Experience as an office manager, executive assistant or in a comparable organisational role.
* Excellent organisation and prioritisation skills, calm and structured under multiple demands.
* High discretion and reliability in handling confidential information.
* Advanced Outlook and MS Office skills.
* Fluent and English; French is a plus.
* Affinity for live entertainment and hosting, willingness to attend selected evening/weekend events.
* Proactive, hands\-on and service\-minded personality.




YOU (BEHAVIOURAL SKILLS)



* You are a highly organised, proactive and dependable professional who enjoys being the trusted go\-to person in a fast\-moving environment.
* You anticipate needs, bring structure to complex priorities and follow through reliably, even when several stakeholders and deadlines compete for attention.
* You communicate with confidence, warmth and tact at all levels—from senior leadership and external partners to colleagues across the business.
* You handle confidential information with sound judgement, absolute discretion and a strong sense of ownership.
* You are service\-minded and naturally create positive experiences for colleagues, clients and VIP guests, with a genuine eye for detail.
* You remain calm, flexible and solutions\-oriented under pressure, especially around events and changing schedules.
* You enjoy working independently while being a collaborative, hands\-on team player who is happy to step in wherever support is needed.
* You take pride in creating an efficient, welcoming and well\-run office environment.
* You have an affinity for live entertainment and enjoy contributing to memorable experiences for fans, partners and the team.




LIFE AT TICKETMASTER



We are proud to be a part of Live Nation Entertainment, the world’s largest live entertainment company.



Our vision at Ticketmaster is to connect people around the world to the live events they love. As the world’s largest ticket marketplace and the leading global provider of enterprise tools and services for the live entertainment business, we are uniquely positioned to successfully deliver on that vision.



We do it all with an intense passion for Live and an inspiring and diverse culture driven by accessible leaders, attentive managers, and enthusiastic teams. If you’re passionate about live entertainment like we are, and you want to work at a company dedicated to helping millions of fans experience it, we want to hear from you.



**Our work is guided by our values:**



**Reliability** \- We understand that fans and clients rely on us to power their live event experiences, and we rely on each other to make it happen.



**Teamwork** \- We believe individual achievement pales in comparison to the level of success that can be achieved by a team



**Integrity** \- We are committed to the highest moral and ethical standards on behalf of the countless partners and stakeholders we represent



**Belonging** \- We are committed to building a culture in which all people can be their authentic selves, have an equal voice and opportunities to thrive



EQUAL OPPORTUNITIES



We are passionate and committed to our people and go beyond the rhetoric of diversity and inclusion. You will be working in an inclusive environment and be encouraged to bring your whole self to work. We will do all that we can to help you successfully balance your work and homelife. As a growing business we will encourage you to develop your professional and personal aspirations, enjoy new experiences, and learn from the talented people you will be working with. It's talent that matters to us and we encourage applications from people irrespective of their gender, race, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability status or caring responsibilities.



HIRING PRACTICES


The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.



Ticketmaster recruitment policies are designed to place the most highly qualified persons available in a timely and efficient manner. Ticketmaster may pursue all avenues available, including promotion from within, employee referrals, outside advertising, employment agencies, internet recruiting, job fairs, college recruiting and search firms. Ticketmaster may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support application screening and assessment. All hiring decisions are made with human review.

Live Nation Entertainment will never request payment or equipment purchases as part of the hiring process. Recruiters will only contact candidates from official Live Nation or affiliated brand email domains.

Global Head of R\&D \| Automated Chemistry
==========================================





**About**

Working at METTLER TOLEDO AutoChem Inc. ( ) means you are impacting the world in important ways. Our process analytical technology and automated synthesis reactors provide scientists in the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and chemical industries the information they need to deliver life\-changing products. As a strategic business unit within , AutoChem develops, manufactures, sells, and services instruments that modernize chemical synthesis, provide insight to every chemical reaction, and provide process knowledge to eliminate scale\-up and safety incidents. * Our instruments increase the efficiency and effectiveness of chemists and engineers.
* Our products help develop profitable, green, and safe scientific processes.
* We help keep you healthy. Our instruments make it possible for scientists to develop new drugs and bring life\-saving medicines to the world.



  
**Our Opening and Your Responsibilities**



**Drive the next generation of laboratory innovation!**





In this critical leadership role, you will define and execute the global R\&D strategy for the **Automated Chemistry business unit**, leading the development of innovative hardware and software solutions that empower scientists and engineers worldwide.





As a member of the AutoChem Functional Management Committee (FMC), you will shape the future technology roadmap, foster a culture of innovation, and ensure the successful delivery of new products that create sustainable customer value and business growth. Leading a highly skilled global R\&D organization across multiple disciplines and locations, you will combine strategic leadership with strong technical engagement to keep AutoChem at the forefront of laboratory automation and process innovation







In this role, your responsibilities will include:





* Own the global R\&D strategy and technology roadmap, aligning innovation priorities, technology investments, and organizational capabilities with AutoChem's long\-term business objectives.
* Lead a global R\&D organization spanning hardware development, software development, systems engineering, systems testing, and project management across multiple locations.
* Drive the development of innovative hardware and software solutions that strengthen AutoChem's market position and enable sustainable business growth.
* a culture of innovation and engineering excellence while continuously evaluating emerging technologies, industry trends, and future technology platforms to unlock long\-term customer and business value.
* Ensure effective execution of global product development programs, balancing robust product lifecycle management processes with the agility required to accelerate innovation and time\-to\-market.

* Own the global R\&D budget, and project roadmap, ensuring effective resource allocation, investment decisions and organizational alignment to maximize innovation impact and business value
* Serve as a key member of the AutoChem Functional Management Committee (FMC), fostering strong partnerships across Product Management, Quality, Operations, Commercial organizations, Digital Business Services, and external technology partners to drive business success.

**What You Need to Succeed**

The following requirements are necessary for this role:





* Master's degree or equivalent qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering, Computer Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a related technical discipline. A PhD is an advantage.
* 10\+ years of progressive leadership experience in R\&D, Engineering, Product Development, or related technical disciplines.
* Proven experience leading global multidisciplinary development organizations across hardware, software, automation, systems engineering, and related technology domains.
* Demonstrated success in developing and commercializing complex technology products within industrial automation, semiconductor, advanced manufacturing, analytical instrumentation, laboratory automation, process technology, or comparable technology\-driven environments.
* Strong technical leadership capabilities with the ability to engage deeply in engineering and technology discussions while providing strategic direction to highly experienced subject matter experts.
* Demonstrated success leading technical experts, engineering managers, and multidisciplinary teams across multiple locations, functions, and technology platforms.
* Proven experience defining and executing technology strategies, innovation roadmaps, and organizational transformation initiatives in a global environment.
* Strong understanding of integrated product ecosystems combining hardware, software, automation, digital solutions, and service offerings.
* Demonstrated success partnering with and influencing senior leadership, driving alignment and execution across complex global matrix organizations.
* Strong business acumen with experience managing significant R\&D investments, budgets, and portfolio prioritization decisions. Experience with ownership of a substantial functional budget is highly desirable.
* A balance of strategic thinking and hands\-on execution, with the ability to translate technology opportunities into measurable business outcomes.
* Native\-level or business fluent English, written and spoken; additional languages are considered an asset.
* Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 25\-30%.



**Our Offer to You**



* Where applicable flexible working hours, a hybrid work model and a wide portfolio of training opportunities
* 40h week with at least 25 vacation days per year plus 4 to 7 additional days off (i.e. in between bank holidays)

title: Aerodynamicist
description:
Join the FIA and play a key role in shaping the aerodynamic landscape and technical future of Formula 1 and premier single-seater racing.
As an Aerodynamicist within the FIA Single Seater Technical Department, you will apply advanced CFD and CAD toolsets with a focus on whole-car concept architecture and macro-aerodynamic behaviour. In this role, your engineering expertise will directly contribute to defining the technical regulations and aerodynamic foundations of the sport. You will evaluate whole-car aerodynamics, wake dynamics, and sporting equity across current cars and clean-sheet future generations—including exploratory research towards the new regulations and the wider single-seater pyramid (Formula 2, Formula 3, Formula Regional, and Formula 4) and Formula E-
Based in Geneva, this newly created role requires working within a lean, multidisciplinary engineering team and includes occasional travel to Formula 1 race and test events (approximately 2 to 3 events per year), occasional visits to team factories, and visits to the FIA office in Geneva

MISSIONS ET RESPONSABILITES :
The role is structured around three core operational pillars:
Aerodynamic Concept & Whole-Car Development (~50–60%)
Whole-Car & Multi-Car Aerodynamic Behaviour: Develop a detailed understanding of whole-car and multi-car aerodynamic behaviour through hands-on use of advanced CFD analysis techniques, directly investigating wake interactions to foster close, competitive racing.
Fundamental Architecture of Future Generations: Contribute to developing methodologies to determine the fundamental architecture and aerodynamic concepts of future single-seater Formula cars (F1, F2, F3, FRegional, and F4)
Development Conditions & Methodologies: Specify the aerodynamic development conditions, calculation methodologies, and physics models to ensure robust and representative aerodynamic solutions, leveraging cloud-based HPC infrastructure.
CAD Scheming & Geometry Generation: Hands-on use of CAD (Siemens NX) and coordination with the FIA’s surface designers to generate geometries and concept models to meet agreed performance objectives, scheme rapid design iterations, and eliminate development bottlenecks.
Aerodynamic Analysis & Reporting: Analyse, report, and present aerodynamic results to internal and external audiences, including FIA colleagues, the commercial rights holder, and the technical leadership of the Formula 1 teams.

Technical Regulations (~20–25%)
Formulation of Technical Regulations: Assist in the formulation of the Technical Regulations to capture the desired characteristics, safety targets, and sporting objectives of future Formula 1 cars.
Legality Interpretations & Team Queries: Review and comment on Formula 1 team legality interpretations, evaluating unconventional competitor proposals and design queries against the published regulations.
CAD-Based Legality Assessment: Participate in CAD-based legality assessments and compliance audits of current Formula 1 cars against the published Technical Regulations.
Trackside & Scrutineering Support: Attend 2 to 3 race/test events as required to provide general support for scrutineering activities (for which the successful candidate will be trained.
Advanced Technology & Tools Exploration (~15–20%)
Aero Testing Restrictions (ATR) Evolution: Remain abreast of the latest Wind Tunnel (WT) and CFD technologies to help steer the future direction of Technical and Operational Regulations relating to Aero Testing Restrictions.
Emerging Tech & Startup Engagement: Collaborate with external technology providers, simulation startups, and research institutions to trial emerging aerodynamic and simulation tools
Internal Tool Development: Develop, automate, and maintain internal aerodynamic post-processing tools, simulation scripts, and data analysis pipelines to continually enhance departmental workflow efficiency.

PROFILE :
University Degree (Master’s or equivalent preferred) in Aeronautical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a closely related discipline.
Minimum 3 to 5 years of hands-on aerodynamic development experience within Formula 1, World Endurance Championship (WEC), or high-level single-seater racing.
In-depth understanding of aerodynamic development workflows, along with practical knowledge of the strengths, limitations, and correlation of both CFD and Wind Tunnel testing.
Proven proficiency in CAD design using Siemens NX or Dassault Systèmes CATIA.
Demonstrated experience in planning, running, analyzing, and synthesizing complex aerodynamic campaigns with rigorous attention to detail and schedule autonomy.
Detailed knowledge of the current Formula 1 Technical Regulations and Aerodynamic Testing Restrictions (ATR) is a strong advantage.
Familiarity with cloud-based simulation environments (HPC), data pipelines, and scientific programming languages (ideally Python) is desirable.
Strong collaborative mindset, autonomy under tight deadlines, and the ability to adapt technical presentations for a wide spectrum of stakeholders.
Native or fluent proficiency in written and spoken English, including the ability to draft clear, concise technical and regulatory documentation.

If you are interested, please send your application in PDF format.

Team Leader Power Electronics Engineering



\_\_

**Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 \- 100%)**



Are you ready to take your passion for traction power electronics to new heights? Whether you're diving into designing powerful traction systems for passenger trains, metros, trams, next generation locomotives, or innovative platform products, this is your chance to make an impact!



Bring your enthusiasm and expertise in power electronics and explore a world of exciting opportunities. You'll be working alongside global teams in engineering, production, R\&D, and project management, all united in pushing the boundaries of technology.



We believe in the power of inclusion, gender equality, and building a diverse environment where every voice is valued. Whether you're expanding your skills or building on past experiences, your unique perspective is essential to driving innovation forward. We’re eager to see what you’ll bring to the table; fresh ideas come from diverse minds.



Reporting to the Power Electronics Engineering Manager, you’ll be part of a team focused on delivering traction projects efficiently, and with high quality through close collaboration, technical excellence, and inclusivity. Ready for the journey?



**Key Responsibilities:**



* **Advanced Systems Engineering**: Design traction power electronics converter and energy storage systems (ESS), while ensuring their seamless integration within vehicles. Your work will align with customer needs, industry standards, and internal specifications.
* **Testing \& Validation**: Lead the specification, execution, analysis, and documentation of Type and Qualification tests to ensure robust system performance, focusing on traction converters and ESS for enhanced energy efficiency.
* **Technical leadership**: Develop deep expertise in core power engineering competencies, components, or tools to provide technical guidance for your peers. Optimize design processes and customer solutions independently or by collaborating in cross\-functional specialist teams.
* **Product Standardization**: Contribute to the evolution of our traction product families through standardization, and continuous improvements. Leverage your expertise to drive innovation in the integration of traction converters with ESS.




**Qualifications for the role:**



* **Power Electronics Expertise:** A qualified Power Electronics/Electrical Engineer with a solid background in power electronics design and engineering. Experience with traction converters and energy storage systems is an advantage.
* **Curiosity \& Continuous Learning:** Eager to continuously expand technical expertise, drive continuous improvement, share knowledge with the team, fostering a culture of growth and collaboration.
* **Problem Solver \& Team Player:** A proactive individual who thrives on solving complex challenges and takes ownership of their tasks, while also being an effective player in an inclusive team.
* **Fluent Communicator:** Clear and efficient communication in English is essential, both written and spoken. language skills are a strong advantage.
* **Willingness to Travel:** Occasional travel opportunities to support projects.




Join us and elevate your career in the thrilling world of **rail vehicle drive systems**! This is your opportunity to thrive and grow while making a meaningful impact on the future of sustainable transportation!

**Power Electronics Engineer for Traction Projects (m/f/d) (80 \- 100%)**



Sind Sie bereit, Ihre Leidenschaft für Traktionsleistungselektronik auf ein neues Level zu heben? Ob Sie leistungsstarke Traktionssysteme für Personenzüge, Metros, Straßenbahnen, Lokomotiven der nächsten Generation oder innovative Plattformprodukte entwickeln – hier haben Sie die Chance, wirklich etwas zu bewegen!



Bringen Sie Ihre Begeisterung und Ihr Fachwissen in der Leistungselektronik ein und entdecken Sie eine Welt voller spannender Möglichkeiten. Sie arbeiten Hand in Hand mit globalen Teams aus den Bereichen Engineering, Produktion, F\&E und Projektmanagement – alle vereint mit dem Ziel, technologische Grenzen zu verschieben.



Wir glauben an die der Inklusion, Gleichstellung der Geschlechter und an den Aufbau eines vielfältigen Umfelds, in dem jede Stimme zählt. Egal ob Sie neue Fähigkeiten entwickeln oder auf bestehenden Erfahrungen aufbauen – Ihre einzigartige Perspektive ist entscheidend, um Innovation voranzutreiben. Wir sind gespannt, was Sie einbringen werden – denn frische Ideen entstehen aus vielfältigen Köpfen.



Sie berichten an den Engineering Manager Power Electronics und sind Teil eines Teams, das sich auf die effiziente und qualitativ hochwertige Umsetzung von Traktionsprojekten konzentriert – durch enge Zusammenarbeit, technische Exzellenz und Inklusion. Bereit für die Reise?



**Hauptaufgaben:**

* **Fortgeschrittenes Systems Engineering:** Entwicklung von Leistungselektronik\-Konvertern und Energiespeichersystemen (ESS) für Traktionsanwendungen sowie Sicherstellung ihrer nahtlosen Integration in Fahrzeuge. Ihre Arbeit orientiert sich an Kundenanforderungen, Industriestandards und internen Spezifikationen.
* **Testen \& Validierung:** Leitung der Spezifikation, Durchführung, Analyse und Dokumentation von Typ\- und Qualifikationstests zur Sicherstellung einer robusten Systemleistung – mit Fokus auf Traktionskonverter und ESS für verbesserte Energieeffizienz.
* **Technische Führung:** Aufbau tiefgehender Expertise in zentralen Power\-Engineering\-Kompetenzen, Komponenten oder Tools, um Ihre Kollegen fachlich zu unterstützen. Optimierung von Designprozessen und Kundenlösungen – eigenständig oder in cross\-funktionalen Spezialistenteams.
* **Produktstandardisierung:** Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung unserer Traktionsproduktfamilien durch Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung. Nutzen Sie Ihr Fachwissen, um Innovation in der Integration von Traktionskonvertern mit ESS voranzutreiben.




**Anforderungen:**

* **Expertise in Leistungselektronik:** Qualifizierter Ingenieur im Bereich Leistungselektronik / Elektrotechnik mit fundiertem Hintergrund in Design und Engineering. Erfahrung mit Traktionskonvertern und Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.
* **Neugier \& kontinuierliches Lernen:** Begeisterung für den stetigen Ausbau technischer Expertise, Förderung kontinuierlicher Verbesserung und Weitergabe von Wissen im Team – für eine Kultur des Wachstums und der Zusammenarbeit.
* **Problemlöser \& Teamplayer:** Eine proaktive Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Herausforderungen liebt, Verantwortung für ihre Aufgaben übernimmt und gleichzeitig ein effektiver Teil eines inklusiven Teams ist.
* **Kommunikationsstärke:** Klare und effiziente Kommunikation auf Englisch ist unerlässlich – schriftlich wie mündlich. Deutschkenntnisse sind ein klarer Vorteil.
* **Reisebereitschaft:** Gelegentliche Reisen zur Projektunterstützung sind möglich.

ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future.
